gh-esengine-deepseek-reasonix.html:
本版加入常用服务预设库和主题包删除，并修复严格网关回放无参数工具调用时的 HTTP 400、卡住的外壳探测拖住内核等问题。

新增

  • 添加模型服务时可以从内核维护的常用预设开始：可搜索、按域名分组，选中后整条预设（模型目录、识图模型、窗口、思考档）原样写入，名称重复由内核判断 (#12645)
  • 外观里可以删除已安装的主题包，需要点两次确认，内置主题没有删除入口 (#12623)

变更

  • 删除模型服务时会说明哪些角色改用了其他服务、哪些被清空，并从 provider_access 里去掉该服务 (#12589)
  • 带密钥的供应商请求（聊天、探测、余额、决策协议）不再跟随跨主机的重定向；被拒时说明被重定向到了哪里，聊天也不再重试十次。如果你的中转站会重定向，把 base URL 改成它重定向到的地址即可 (#12570)
  • 每天的第一个回合会告诉模型当天日期，只放在回合末尾，不改变缓存前缀 (#12598)
  • reasonix upgrade 遇到由 npm 或 Homebrew 安装的程序，会提示用对应的包管理器升级，不再自己替换文件 (#12578)
  • 检查通过之后才写入的文档不再要求再验证一次；有工具钩子或边车介入时仍然要求验证 (#12560)

修复

  • 严格的网关在回放无参数的工具调用时返回 HTTP 400「arguments must be valid JSON」：空参数现在发送 {}，已保存的会话保持原样 (#12745)
  • 外壳探测整体有时限，一次卡住的探测不再拖住内核，也不会反复重新启动 (#12615)
  • 本地 .mcp.json 等清单有大小上限，安装被拒时会写明具体原因 (#12641)
  • 内部：Windows 更新助手移除、配置迁移合并为一次读取、启动输入显式绑定、测试稳定性 (#12594, #12592, #12555, #12742)

What's Changed

  • fix(providers): keep key-carrying provider requests on the configured origin by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12570
  • fix(readiness): prose written after a passing check owes no second run by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12560
  • feat(providers): report the roles a removal moved or cleared and prune provider_access by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12589
  • feat(control): tell the model the calendar date on the turn tail, once per day by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12598
  • feat(providers): offer the kernel's curated presets when adding a source by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12645
  • fix(sandbox): bound shell discovery as a whole so a stalled lookup cannot hold the kernel handshake by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12615
  • perf(config): run the retired-key migrations over one read of each config by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12592
  • fix(installsource): bound a local .mcp.json and name the cause of a refused install by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12641
  • perf(boot): bind every storage root Build resolves to its stated home by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12555
  • fix(upgrade): leave npm-installed binaries to npm by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12578
  • refactor(update): remove the unused Windows update helper from studio by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12594
  • feat(studio): delete a theme pack from Appearance by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12623
  • fix(provider): replay a tool call with no arguments as an empty object by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12745
  • docs(release): Studio 2.37.0 notes by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12746
  • fix(e2ebench): fail mutation and differential analysis when source restoration fails by @chuiwenwei in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12562
  • fix(serve): send an empty sessions list for a folder with no conversations by @jipeng6036-del in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12744

New Contributors

  • @jipeng6036-del made their first contribution in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12744

Full Changelog: https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/compare/studio-v2.36.0...studio-v2.37.0

macOS 已用 Developer ID 签名并公证，打开时不需要清除隔离属性。Windows 的窗口、内核与安装器都经 Certum 代码签名证书做了 Authenticode 签名。Linux Debian 系从 .deb 安装，Fedora、RHEL、openSUSE 等从 .rpm 安装（sudo dnf install ./ReasonixStudio-linux-amd64.rpm）。

三个平台都能自更新：Linux 的 .deb 走自己的包（.rpm 的自更新尚未提供，请手动下载新包），Windows 运行下一个安装器，macOS 替换自身 bundle。

gh-esengine-deepseek-reasonix.summary: 本版加入提问等待超时、可选提示音、可选的折叠中间过程、每回合运行时长、改动文件条、工作区额外文件夹设置和编辑连接时更改协议，回执卡改为默认隐藏，并修复 1M 窗口每轮 400、存储迁移卡在校验、滚轮抖动、模型切换被后台任务挡住、Linux 与 Windows 更新等问题。 新增 新增可选的提问等待超时（默认关闭）：设置的会话页、[agent] ask_timeout_seconds 或终端 /ask-timeout 开启后，无人回答的提问超时即跳过，并告诉模型这是超时而非你的回答 (#12661)…
gh-esengine-deepseek-reasonix.html:
本版加入提问等待超时、可选提示音、可选的折叠中间过程、每回合运行时长、改动文件条、工作区额外文件夹设置和编辑连接时更改协议，回执卡改为默认隐藏，并修复 1M 窗口每轮 400、存储迁移卡在校验、滚轮抖动、模型切换被后台任务挡住、Linux 与 Windows 更新等问题。

新增

  • 新增可选的提问等待超时（默认关闭）：设置的会话页、[agent] ask_timeout_seconds 或终端 /ask-timeout 开启后，无人回答的提问超时即跳过，并告诉模型这是超时而非你的回答 (#12661)
  • 每个回合结束后显示它运行了多久，重新载入历史后仍能看到；失败或被取消的回合不显示，旧会话也不补造 (#12656)
  • 输入框上方新增改动文件条，显示「N 个文件已更改 +x -y」，点击打开工作台文件列表；默认开启，可在会话设置里关闭，非 git 工作区不显示 (#12668)
  • 外观的行宽新增「整宽，输入框也铺满」，默认不变，需要时自己选；手机宽度不受影响 (#12703)
  • 设置的「工具与权限」里新增「此项目的额外文件夹」：可添加、移除让 agent 额外可写的文件夹，只对本项目生效，拒绝时给出带代码的原因，默认没有；「完全放行」只决定是否询问，不会扩大可写范围 (#12640, #12715)
  • 新增可选的提示音（默认关闭）：设置的通知里打开后，回合结束、等待批准、模型提问和反馈回复时放一声短提示，不依赖系统通知，窗口在后台也会响 (#12702)
  • 新增可选的「折叠中间过程」（默认关闭，[ui] fold_turn_work）：已结束的一轮只留最后一句，中间的工具调用、思考和中间文字收成一行，点开展开，运行中的一轮始终展开 (#12714)
  • 设置的版本页新增「日志与异常退出记录」：显示日志目录和异常退出留下的文件，不上传任何东西 (#12719)
  • 编辑连接时可以更改协议，不必删掉重建；决策来源不显示该选项，已固定请求地址的连接会被拒绝并说明原因 (#12618)
  • 界面字体与代码字体的建议列表大幅扩充，在 Windows 上不再几乎没有可选项 (#12708)
  • 斜杠菜单里的 MCP 提示词会列出它声明的参数，并标明必填或可选，Studio 和终端界面都有 (#12700)
  • 窗口关闭后重新打开，会回到上次的大小、位置和最大化状态 (#12624)
  • 不带任务编号调用 bash_output 时，列出正在运行的后台任务及其开始时间，模型不必自己记任务编号 (#12627)

变更

  • 回执卡默认隐藏：有未验证的改动时只留一行，点击展开；在设置里或 [ui] show_receipt 可恢复显示，终端界面读同一个设置 (#12721)
  • 打开工作台时先出入口页（文件、改动、浏览器），不再替你打开浏览器；标题栏的浏览器按钮仍直达浏览器 (#12648)
  • 侧栏开关只有一个且位置不变，会话项点击有动作，同一模型连续回复只在首条显示头像和名字 (#12647)
  • 运行分析的信号栏说明它是什么、为什么标记不能拖；窄窗口加高缩放下标题栏折成一个按钮，不再互相压住 (#12646, #12616)
  • 宿主拒绝过的调用会在下一轮告诉模型（只回传确定不可重试的几类），被拒说明也不再写「本会话剩余时间」 (#12697)
  • 本机模型的验证超时单独说明「本机服务没有在时限内回答，模型可能仍在加载」，本机等待放宽到 60 秒，远程仍是 20 秒 (#12704)
  • 设置、用量等机器级页面在远程窗格里也绑定本机运行时，被替换的控制器的货币保存会被拒绝 (#12674 by @XTLine)
  • 悬停提示延迟 0.3 秒，键盘聚焦不延迟 (#12707)
  • 只剩后台任务时也可以切换模型、思考档、窗口、服务或恢复会话：任务继续运行并交给新的运行时，不再被「仍有后台任务」挡住；回合进行中仍会被拒绝 (#12622)
  • 计划模式下调用 browser_open 被拒时，说明原因并建议改用 web_fetch (#12678 by @xlyy1)
  • 通知设置的说明改为如实：总开关默认关闭，前台和后台都会提醒，系统提示音由系统决定，没有单独的声音设置 (#12677)
  • 只读代理现在可以搜索能力目录，不再被误报「未知的动态能力操作」 (#12582)
  • 权限规则可以写 system_one、advise、best_of_n 等仅在特定装配下存在的工具，不再保存时被拒或载入时被报失效 (#12565)
  • 安装计划和插件警告里来自软件包的文字统一按显示场景处理：控制字符不再截断整句，隐藏字符不再悄悄被删 (#12630, #12636)
  • MCP 登录判定改为按 401 的 Bearer 质询和凭据情况，不再靠错误文字里有没有「auth」；没有质询的 401 与 403 现在显示为可重试 (#12613)

修复

  • 存储位置迁移不再在「正在校验」处看似卡死：校验按文件汇报进度，迁移期间继续写入的文件会再次复制，仍不稳定则拒绝并保持原样；校验后又被写过的旧目录会保留；目标目录被拒时列出多余条目 (#12740)
  • 向上滚动长对话时不再抽搐或跳到上一条 (#12706)
  • 还没有输出的运行中调用可以展开，写明命令仍在运行、已运行多久和它自带的超时 (#12720)
  • 恢复 Goal 会真的开始追求，对被阻塞的 Goal 回复后恢复追求；被拒绝的提交带通知码，排队的前端不再说「请重发」 (#12655, #12654)
  • 模型显式交回（阻塞或等待用户）后，宿主不再继续续跑；仍在运行的后台任务算看不见的写入者，通过符号链接写入会记录实际写到哪里 (#12651, #12586, #12619)
  • 通用的 400 说明不再说「通常是程序缺陷」，附上服务给出的原因 (#12710)
  • 上下文接近 1M 时每一轮都返回 HTTP 400：补全预留改为随窗口按比例留出，没有错误码的 400 也会折叠上下文后重放，折叠失败时错误里会写明原因 (#12698, Fixes #12694 fixed in #12698)
  • Responses 协议的流在工具调用不完整时不再悄悄丢掉其中一个，而是判为失败重试 (#12558 by @XTLine)
  • 发给 Responses 的图片补上 detail 字段，官方 OpenAI 地址不再拒收；400 或 422 时在服务返回的文字旁显示本机发出的请求形状，便于排查 (#12666, #12667)
  • stdio 的 MCP 服务若对探测不应答又在收到非 initialize 的首条消息时退出，现在改在新进程上握手，不再等到超时报 context deadline exceeded (#12621)
  • 已写入磁盘的改动被扩展的 tool.after 报告为失败后，不再从改动记录里消失，改完代码仍会要求验证 (#12614)
  • 回执判断某个路径是否属于宿主自己的目录时，改在调用发生时判断，并把各种链接（含 Windows 联接点）和 .. 都视为不属于 (#12632)
  • 删除模型服务被拒时，原因显示在删除按钮旁，并同步清掉所有引用该服务的角色，窗口很矮时也看得到 (#12573)
  • 决策协议的来源不再显示「读取可用模型」按钮 (#12568)
  • 关闭右侧边栏后，滚动条不再被拖拽热区盖住，可以直接拖动；各分栏的拖拽条也不再压住相邻滚动条 (#12620)
  • 重写消息的输入框改为占满所在行，不再只有一个窄的文本框 (#12626)
  • 停靠的浏览器栏从窗格顶部开始，不再空出一截 (#12650)
  • 模型思考时输入一行，思考内容不再被拆成两块 (#12673)
  • 在一个窗口里归档或改动会话后，其他窗口的会话列表会跟着刷新 (#12664 by @par73e)
  • 通知里的占位符（文件名、数量、规则）现在统一替换，不再原样显示 {n}、{name} (#12642)
  • 扩展的几类告警分开计数，一类不再吞掉另一类；重建后缺失边车程序的通知不再丢失；同一条构建期通知在重建时只出现一次 (#12669 by @XTLine, #12690, #12581)
  • 模型的推理被长度上限截断而没有正文时，告知是上限所致，不再只说「别只发推理」 (#12625)
  • 被取消的子任务的记录会交给父任务，但不会被当作答案 (#12628)
  • Linux 的 .deb 更新程序现在接受 reasonix-studio 包名，不再在校验后以 package_rejected 拒绝；.deb 的 CI 校验同步加上 (#12662)
  • Windows 更新时以 --updated 启动安装程序，更新后桌面快捷方式和任务栏固定得以保留 (#12675)
  • Windows 点击系统通知会把 Studio 窗口带到前面 (#12699)
  • 反馈表单的系统一栏按构建号显示「Windows 11」，不再只显示 NT 10.0 而被误认为 Windows 10 (#12701)
  • 后台任务完成等由宿主排队的回合，开始时现在会宣告，界面不再看似无事发生 (#12705)
  • 排队的一行被内核判为无法送达后，会从对话记录里撤下，不再一直显示「等待中」，与队列面板一致 (#12713)
  • Linux 托盘菜单只在内容变化时才重建，避免定时替换把打开着的菜单关掉；这是对一个托盘问题的加固，未确认为根因 (#12709)
  • 附件、壁纸、主题包过大时先拒绝再读入内存，不再因几百 MB 的压缩包耗尽内存 (#12711, #12712)
  • 外壳探测遇到卡住的 bash 一分钟内不再重复启动；网络位置（UNC 共享）上的 bash 与 PowerShell 一律不再被用作 shell (#12633, #12635)
  • 自动安装 .mcp.json 被拒时，保留并显示被拒的原因，不再当作没有这个文件 (#12571 by @xxoingr)
  • 内部：会话旁文件每次事务只读一次并缓存已验证的信任对象，后台命令的退出码和信号改为带类型字段，用户消息的附件改为字段而非文本匹配 (#12653, #12638, #12634)
  • 内部：评测统计、持续集成、依赖升级、官网与技能镜像、赞助鸣谢等不影响使用的改动 (#12629, #12631, #12679, #12681, #12686, #12687, #12639, #12649, #12659, #12612)
  • 内部：测试与基线检查修复、评测记录与语料守卫 (#12607, #12718, #12737, #12739, #12494 by @chuiwenwei, #12495 by @chuiwenwei, #12500 by @chuiwenwei)

贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@XTLine、@xlyy1、@par73e、@xxoingr、@chuiwenwei

gh-esengine-deepseek-reasonix.html:
本版加入 Linux 的 rpm 安装包、MCP 工具定义固定与变更扣留、闲置会话自动归档、硬件加速开关和反馈回复通知，并修复信任库无限增长、新会话默认模型被跳过时无提示等问题。

新增

  • 新增 Linux 的 .rpm 安装包（ReasonixStudio-linux-*.rpm），本版是首个含 rpm 的版本；用 minisign 校验，无 GPG 签名；rpm 安装的版本暂不自动更新 (#12608)
  • MCP 工具定义在你批准时被固定：之后有变化或新增的工具会被扣住，不进入模型请求，调用会被明确拒绝，直到用 reasonix mcp trust <名称> --digest <摘要> 批准；桌面端目前只显示通知 (#12597)
  • 设置的外观页新增「图形」：可关闭硬件加速（下次启动生效），并显示当前窗口的绘制方式；窗口无法绘制时，可用环境变量 REASONIX_DISABLE_GPU=1 或参数 --disable-gpu 仅关闭这一次 (#12451)
  • 设置新增可选的闲置会话自动归档（默认关闭，默认 30 天，范围 1 到 3650）；已置顶、正在运行、有待回答事项或有未读完成的会话不会被归档，归档可恢复 (#11535)
  • 反馈的未读角标在应用打开期间自动刷新，窗口不在前台时有新回复会弹出通知；通知设置里新增「反馈有回复时」开关，在总开关打开时默认开启 (#11538)
  • 设置的「关于」页新增「支持项目」入口，含 PayPal 链接以及默认折叠的微信、支付宝收款码 (#11709)

变更

  • 提交接口 POST /submit 只在提交确实被丢弃时返回 409；已受理并立刻结束的回合、排在结束中回合之后的提交现在返回 202 (#12596)
  • 电脑操作返回给模型的应用名和窗口标题现在限长并转义，包含换行或不可见字符的名称不再能伪造快照行 (#12585)
  • 安装 skill 或本地插件时，复制的来源若是指向目录的别名现在可以安装；批准之后来源别名被改指向别处，会被拒绝而不会复制 (#12112 by @KHG420)

修复

  • 信任库 trusted/ 目录不再无限增长：密封记录不再把合同的验收条目复制进每一回合，义务清单改为只存一份并按摘要引用 (#12609, Fixes #12603 fixed in #12609)
  • 新会话的默认模型是决策来源而被跳过时，终端界面和 reasonix run 现在给出「默认模型不可用」的通知，不再静默改用别的模型 (#12605 by @xxoingr)

贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@KHG420、@xxoingr

What's Changed

  • test(serve): wait for a trace turn to go silent, not for a fixed time by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12599
  • fix(repolint): wire-parity reads embedded structs and extends, declares PermissionRules by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12590
  • perf(gitcmd): skip the driver listing for subcommands that cannot run a driver by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12588
  • fix(computer): bound and escape application names in the snapshot and app list by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12585
  • fix(serve): judge POST /submit by what admission did with it by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12596
  • feat(studio): opt-in archiving of conversations inactive for N days by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/11535
  • fix(config): report a skipped default on the new-session path too by @xxoingr in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12605
  • feat(studio): switch hardware acceleration off and show how the window is drawn by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12451
  • feat(release): build and publish an rpm of Studio for Linux by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12608
  • feat(feedback): refresh the unread badge while open and announce new replies by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/11538
  • feat(studio): add a Support entry to Settings > About by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/11709
  • fix(installsource): copy directory root aliases by @KHG420 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12112
  • fix(agent): stop copying the contract's criteria into every sealed bundle by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12609
  • feat(plugin): pin MCP tool definitions at approval and hold changed tools by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12597
  • docs(release): Studio 2.35.0 notes by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12610

Full Changelog: https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/compare/studio-v2.34.0...studio-v2.35.0

macOS 已用 Developer ID 签名并公证，打开时不需要清除隔离属性。Windows 的窗口、内核与安装器都经 Certum 代码签名证书做了 Authenticode 签名。Linux Debian 系从 .deb 安装，Fedora、RHEL、openSUSE 等从 .rpm 安装（sudo dnf install ./ReasonixStudio-linux-amd64.rpm）。

三个平台都能自更新：Linux 的 .deb 走自己的包（.rpm 的自更新尚未提供，请手动下载新包），Windows 运行下一个安装器，macOS 替换自身 bundle。

gh-esengine-deepseek-reasonix.summary: 本版让输入框可以直接切换工作区的本地分支，界面缩放改用统一范围并支持 Ctrl/Cmd +/-/0，电脑操作能判断每一步是否生效，并修复回退冲突、旧版会话导入、模型切换、GLM 思考参数和多处终端界面的问题。 新增 输入框的分支标签读取真实的 git 状态，并可直接把工作区切换到另一个本地分支；有进行中的回合、后台任务或未提交改动时会明确拒绝并说明原因 (#12092 by @XTLine, #12171 by @XTLine) 界面缩放只有一个声明范围 0.8 到 1.8（步长…
gh-esengine-deepseek-reasonix.html:
本版让输入框可以直接切换工作区的本地分支，界面缩放改用统一范围并支持 Ctrl/Cmd +/-/0，电脑操作能判断每一步是否生效，并修复回退冲突、旧版会话导入、模型切换、GLM 思考参数和多处终端界面的问题。

新增

  • 输入框的分支标签读取真实的 git 状态，并可直接把工作区切换到另一个本地分支；有进行中的回合、后台任务或未提交改动时会明确拒绝并说明原因 (#12092 by @XTLine, #12171 by @XTLine)
  • 界面缩放只有一个声明范围 0.8 到 1.8（步长 0.05），滑块显示的值就是实际保存的值，并可用 Ctrl/Cmd 加 +、-、0 调整 (#12035)
  • 电脑操作的每一步会标明效果是否可信，并带上占住输入的模态对话框；Windows 上输入文字会读回确认，被错误框挡住时不再假装成功 (#12541, #12542)
  • 自动压缩因上次摘要失败而被暂缓时，界面和终端界面会显示一条中英文提示，不再静默 (#12083)
  • 终端界面输入框为空时按回车，回到最新输出并继续跟随，与 1.x 一致；Ctrl+Z 把终端界面挂起到命令行，fg 后恢复 (#12510 by @xxoingr, #12511 by @xxoingr)
  • 思考参数面板按协议声明的字段命名，Responses 协议的服务商不再显示成只支持 Chat (#12498)

变更

  • 侧栏底部的用量、反馈、账号和设置，在图标栏可见时不再重复显示；图标栏隐藏、仅折叠时显示或窄窗口下仍保留 (#12482 by @SivanCola)
  • 显式声明 glm 协议的服务，glm-5.2、glm-5.3、glm-5.3-flash 的请求现在带 reasoning_effort：5.2 选 high 真发 high，选 none 真关思考；5.3 的「关闭」发 thinking=enabled 加 low (#12552)
  • 决策来源不再出现在输入框的模型切换器里，选它会得到明确错误，而不是不可预期的失败 (#12553)
  • 已保存的决策来源点「测试连接」时，改走它自己的协议并给出分类错误，不再提示「加 /v1」 (#12546)
  • 配置编辑锁目录改放在用户主目录下，遇到属于他人的目录时给出明确错误，不再报一个裸的权限错误 (#11374 by @drakeo338)
  • 权限规则写成不对应任何已注册工具的裸命令（如 ask = ["rm"]）时会被报告并拒绝，不再静默失效 (#12536)
  • 安装计划里来自软件包的文字（版本、名称、路径、警告等）现在限长并清除控制字符，.mcp.json 声明的服务数超限会被拒绝 (#12037, #12512 by @xxoingr)

修复

  • 代码回退之后再次回退同一回合或更早的回合，不再误报文件冲突；回退确认里的文件数按整个回退范围统计 (#11572 by @Guan0923, #11692 by @Guan0923)
  • 打开 1.x 会话时不再多出一份同名副本 (#12506)
  • 导入 1.x 目录时，读不了的会话会逐条列出并附带原因，不再只给一个警告数量 (#12538)
  • 模型切换被拒时区分是回合仍在运行还是只剩后台任务，并说明各自的处理办法 (#12505)
  • 模型切换后，已接入的拦截器类扩展不再失效，也不再误报其服务已停止 (#12367 by @KHG420)
  • Windows 上通过注册表里的安装路径找到 Git Bash，回退到 PowerShell 时明确告知；外壳探测有时限且结果会保存，不再拖慢启动 (#12486, #12539)
  • Git 低于 2.31 时，工作区不再被误判为「不是仓库」而丢失状态、提交和分支标签 (#12518)
  • 压缩摘要因输出上限被截断时，自动用加倍的上限重试一次 (#12469)
  • 计划模式拒绝调用时，说明被拒的命令、原因类别和可行的出路 (#12517)
  • 本回合只改了 .md/.rst 文档时，不再被要求运行验证命令 (#12520)
  • 交付卡片不再把主机自己的任务快照、工具缓存和 .git 当作改动，也不再给中文用户显示英文句子 (#12465)
  • 后台任务完成、终止、失败的提示改为按界面语言显示 (#12476)
  • 提问卡片的自由文字输入框始终可见，运行状态明确写为等待你的回答 (#12540)
  • 图标栏的悬停提示不再被裁掉或被遮住 (#12468)
  • 重写已发送消息的输入框与队列行的编辑框随文字长度调整高度，长段落不再只露出两行 (#12477)
  • 记忆页保存时，较新的草稿不会被先前的保存完成而清掉，各条记忆的写入按钮分别保持禁用 (#12135 by @KHG420)
  • 切换设置里的连接后，软件包安装表单和更新锁不再沿用上一个连接的内容 (#12126 by @KHG420)
  • 技能安装和注册的结果只报告所选来源自己的文件，同名技能被遮蔽时给出警告，目录别名也会被跟随 (#12107 by @KHG420, #12109 by @KHG420, #12110 by @KHG420)
  • memory 工具的搜索和列表在丢弃结果时会注明丢了多少条，模型不再把截断当作完整 (#12104 by @chuiwenwei)
  • 宿主日志不再被例行请求刷满，内核异常退出时留下可读的崩溃记录 (#12523)

贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@XTLine、@xxoingr、@SivanCola、@drakeo338、@Guan0923、@KHG420、@chuiwenwei

What's Changed

  • fix(studio): keep adopted interceptors working after model switches by @KHG420 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12367
  • docs(readme): add a sponsor slot for PackyCode by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12470
  • fix(studio): scope package installation forms to connection by @KHG420 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12126
  • fix(studio): preserve memory drafts and pending writes by @KHG420 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12135
  • fix(config): keep the config edit lock directory per user and refuse a foreign owner by @drakeo338 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/11374
  • fix(checkpoint): sync file state after code rewind to prevent false conflicts by @Guan0923 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/11572
  • feat(memory): report omitted matches on the memory tool paths by @chuiwenwei in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12104
  • chore(repolint): declare six look.ts wire mirrors by @f1shsmell in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12389
  • docs(studio): run scenario exercises from installed packages by @KHG420 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12099
  • fix(installsource): report skill installation shadowing accurately by @KHG420 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12107

goose.html:
🪿 Goose v1.30.0 Release Notes

Released: April 8, 2026

✨ New Features

🖥️ Terminal UI (TUI) Overhaul
  • Tab-expandable tool calls — tool call output now collapses cleanly with tab to expand (#8136)
  • Improved message rendering — better ordering, streaming/scrolling, and overall visual polish for messages, tool calls, and text entry (#8144, #8156, #8214)
  • Independent --text mode — text mode is now decoupled from the normal TUI for a cleaner headless experience (#8210)
  • goose serve — new subcommand to run Goose as a background service (#8209)
🔌 Providers & Models
  • Gemini OAuth provider — first-class OAuth-based authentication for Google Gemini (#8129)
  • Copilot ACP provider — new provider for GitHub Copilot via ACP (#8154)
  • Zhipu declarative provider — adds Zhipu AI with configurable ZHIPU_BASE_URL override (#8204)
  • Configurable fast_model for declarative providers — lets you specify a lightweight model for quick tasks (#8194)
  • Gemma 4 local model support — enable Gemma 4 as a local model option (#8366)
  • VMware Tanzu Platform provider improvements — bug fixes, streaming support, and UI enhancements (#8126)
🛡️ Security & Observability
  • Egress logging inspector — new security feature to log and inspect outbound network calls (#8149)
  • Restricted secrets file permissions — secrets files are now created with tighter OS-level permissions (#8118)
🧩 Extensions & Skills
  • Show installed skills in UI — skills are now visible and browsable from the desktop app (#7910)
  • Skills platform extension — skills are now managed as a dedicated platform extension (#8377)
  • Recursively discover nested skills — skills under configured roots are now found at any depth (#8082)
  • Configurable extension timeouts — set timeouts per-extension via ACP _meta or a global default (#8295)
  • Reusable ACP provider controls — shared UI components for ACP provider configuration (#8314)
  • Rust ACP client for extension methods (#8227)
  • Developer MCP server enhancements (#7770)
🌐 Internationalization
  • i18n infrastructure — added react-intl based internationalization framework to the desktop app (#8105)
🩺 Diagnostics
  • goose doctor — new command to diagnose common configuration and environment issues (#8342)
⚙️ Configuration
  • GOOSE_SHOW_FULL_OUTPUT — new config option to disable tool output truncation (#7919)
  • GOOSE_CLI_SHOW_THINKING — can now be set in config.yaml (not just env vars) (#8097)
  • GOOSE_CONTEXT_LIMIT — now readable from config.yaml (#7900)
  • GOOSE_DISABLE_KEYRING — now honoured from config.yaml at startup (#8219)
  • Per-delegate max_turns override (#8066)
  • skip_canonical_filtering for declarative providers (#8052)
🏗️ Build & Packaging
  • Optional native-tls support — alternative to rustls for environments that need system TLS (#8037)
  • Feature-gated AWS provider dependencies — behind aws-providers feature flag for leaner builds (#8080)
  • Feature-gated telemetry — telemetry is now behind Cargo feature flags (#8119)
  • Inference Mesh settings tab (#8094)

🐛 Bug Fixes

Providers
  • Fix user message text silently dropped when message contains both text and image (#8071)
  • Send empty object instead of null for Bedrock tool input (#8121)
  • Fall back to configured models when the models endpoint fetch fails (#7530)

crush.html:
Catwalk v3, hooks!

A big one! Crush now runs on Catwalk v3, hooks can see every part of a run, and editors that host Crush get a whole new set of tools to feel right at home.

Small overview of Catwalk v3:

Crush now speaks Catwalk v3. Provider type describes the API format a provider uses, not who made it:

  • completions: OpenAI-compatible APIs
  • responses: OpenAI, or anything routed through it
  • messages: Anthropic-compatible APIs

Your config is migrated automatically when it loads, so openai, openai-compat and anthropic keep working. No edits needed.

The provider add and model add flags follow along:

crush provider add deepseek \
  --type completions \
  --base-url "https://api.deepseek.com/v1" \
  --api-key "$DEEPSEEK_API_KEY"

crush model add deepseek/deepseek-chat --thinking toggleable --max-attachments 5
  • --can-reason is now --thinking always|never|toggleable
  • --max-attachments N is new
  • Reasoning levels show friendly names in the picker, like "X-High"

Hooks, everywhere 🪝

Hooks are no longer just about tools. They can now follow the whole run: sessions, turns, permissions and more!

Hooks are now checked against the list of known events, so a typo gets caught early. The docs cover each event and how it lines up with Claude Code.

Client/server mode

If you build something that runs Crush inside it, this release is for you:

  • Host themes: the host app can theme the TUI over the server API, so Crush matches your applications.
  • Host context: the host can tell Crush what's in view, like open files, and those files appear in completions.
  • Append to the next prompt: clients can add text the agent reads with the next prompt, without starting a run or cluttering the chat.
  • Shared viewing: clients can see which session other clients are looking at.
  • Piped permissions: set CRUSH_PERMISSIONS_PIPED=1 and the host answers permission prompts, so you aren't asked twice.
  • http:// addresses work as an alias for tcp:// when starting the server.

Steadier server

  • SIGHUP now reloads the config instead of stopping the server.
  • Closing the terminal or stopping Crush through a service manager now shuts down gracefully, so work in progress is saved instead of left looking stuck.

That's all for now! Charm XX 💫

Thoughts? Questions? We love hearing from you. Feel free to reach out on X, Discord, Slack, The Fediverse, Bluesky.

crush.html:
Rex, OSC 7501, xAI/Grok OAuth and more

Hey! There’s some good quality of life stuff in this release. Let’s take a look!

It’s Rex Time

Following an update on Bubbletea Crush now supports the Program Status Protocol, aka OSC 7501, created by Superlogical for Rex! As a bonus, TUIOS also supports the protocol.

x.AI OAuth

Now Crush supports Grok OAuth login. Enjoy!

Many more fixes

A lot of fixes were introduced this version:

  • Server side improvements by @meowgorithm
  • External editor swallowing empty buffer
  • Models behind OAuth couldn't be used if they weren't in Catwalk
  • Fixed MCP toggled misbehavior

And a lot more from @taciturnaxolotl. Read all below!

Good luck, Charm XX 👋🏻

Crushed It!

This release introduces many new features that improve QoL by a ton! Brought to you by Charm and our favorite contributors!

Toggle MCPs

Thanks to awesome @BrunoKrugel, you can now turn off MCP servers from the UI, globally, or locally.

Git Branches

At last: @taciturnaxolotl and @Gustave-241021 have brought Git branch display to Crush, which is so useful.

More UI and QoL changes:

  • ChatGPT OAuth now refreshes with Catwalk
  • Claude Channels, part 2/3 by @joestump
  • Toggle Sidebar on and off with ctrl+b by @andreynering
  • Quit dialog improvements and mouse support by @meowgorithm

Fixed!

  • Fixed clipboard false reporting successful copies by @taciturnaxolotl
  • Count Anthropic cache-creating tokens by @yanyukang2003-ux
  • Correctly resolving the project data directory in session and stats by @devYRPauli

This release is filled with improvements! Read more below!

See you next time, Charm XX 🔆

Quick little theme API adjustment

Hey! ICYMI we released support for themes a few hours ago. Before they get too widely adopted, we’re making one small breaking API change to the names of keys.:

insert_bg -> insert_code_bg delete_bg -> delete_code_bg

This is what it looks like in code:

{
  // ...
  "diff_insert_fg": "#629657",
  "diff_insert_code_bg": "#2d3431",
  "diff_insert_gutter_bg": "#282d2c",
  "diff_delete_fg": "#a45c59",
  "diff_delete_code_bg": "#33272d",
  "diff_delete_gutter_bg": "#2a232a",
  // ...
}

Themes and more!

This release is HUGE and we are so excited to share what our team and contributors have done!

The long awaited feature!

Crush now has themes! 🎨 Open the new Themes dialog from the command palette to switch looks with live preview, try the built-in Gruvbox Dark, or create and edit your own custom palettes right inside the TUI. Thank @meowgorithm and @gurnben for this feature!

crush.html:
Hello, Plan Mode

This release introduces many improvements but, most importantly, and a solid new feature from one of our very talented contributors:

Let’s plan

At last, thanks to the very talented work of @vadiminshakov and @andrinoff, we present the long awaited Plan Mode.

Plan Mode is for…planning. Talk to the agent, answer questions, and put together a plan and then, when you’re ready, get to to work. You can activate plan mode with shift+tab.

@andreynering and @taciturnaxolotl marched forward in the quest for max perf in this release. Details below.

That's all for now. See you soon!

crush.html:
ChatGPT subs, non-interactive improvements, and a touch of perf

This is a pretty solid release with some nice contributions from both the Charm team and one of our fave contributors. Let's go!

Use your ChatGPT subscription in Crush

If you love Crush and your ChatGPT subscription you’ll love this release. Enjoy!

Non-interactive mode: reasoning

Headless Crush users now get more control with a new --reasoning-effort flag in crush run. Go crazy and orchestrate to the max!

If you (or your agent) mistypes a reasoning effort you'll get the proper accepted values, too.

crush run --model "hyper/glm-5.3" --reasoning-effort "max"

Shredding the perf

@taigrr contributed a bunch of solid performance improvements to scrolling and spinners. Mouse scroll events are coalesced, chat scrolls are memoized and the spinners all use a shared clock. This stuff is really good: check it out.

Choppin’ off 4MB

We also ripped the Swagger stuff from client-server mode with a hand-rolled—but fully OpenAPI v3.2.1 compliant—implementation. This shaved about 4MB off the binary and will nullify chances of in the long run. Thanks, Go type system!

Have a great weekend, Charm 💌

crush.html:
Disable mouse support + more

Hey, how's your week going? We have a few changes today, including mostly fixes but also a few nice additions.

Disable mouse support

Want to disable mouse support in Crush? Feel lucky because our favorite contributor @timotheosh added just that.

With the config below you can achieve that. It's also possible to toggle it via the command palette dialog.

crushrc:

option ui mouse false

crush.json:

{ "options": { "tui": { "mouse": false } } }

Fixed UX for non-vision models

In some cases, Crush were allowing you to attach an image even when the selected model was not vision-capable. The attachment was then being silent dropped in the request.

Now, we're properly validating it and showing a message so you know when it's not supported.

Fixed some models on GitHub Copilot

On Copilot some models only works on the /responses endpoint: named GPT-6 Astra and the Grok models.

Fixed some models on OpenCode Zen & Go

OpenCode also require some models to use specific endpoints. Not every model support the /chat/completions endpoint; some require /responses or /messages.

We fixed this issue for the models OpenCode currently supports.

Fixed Sentry MCP + others

A misconfiguration made it impossible to authenticate with OAuth2 with a few the MCPs, including the Sentry MCP. This is now fixed!

Fixed potential memory leak

@caniko discovered a memory leak, specifically when discover_models: true is set. This issue was fixed!

To read the technical explanation, see #3162 and #3683.

See you in the next release! The Charm Team :tm:

crush.html:
Text selection and better mouse support

Just a few QOL improvements to the prompt editor and session picker for the weekend!

Text selection

Hold shift and use the arrow keys or click and drag with your mouse to select text in the prompt editor. From there, you can use any of the fancy new shortcuts 👀

  • ctrl+shift+a selects everything
  • ctrl+shift+c copies the selection
  • ctrl+shift+x cuts the selection
  • ctrl+shift+v pastes text

Typing or pasting over selected text replaces it.

Mouse support in the session picker

We've been missing mouse support in the session picker for too long! You can now scroll through sessions with the mouse wheel, click an entry to select it, or double-click to open it.

A small Windows fix

Pressing a modifier key by itself could send some dialogs back to the top on Windows. They should stay put now.

Keep crushing! Charm 💌

crush.html:
A couple QoL goodies

We're releasing a few Quality of Life :tm: enhacements for you. They're simple, but these simple improvements compound with time to make Crush better and better.

Hint on quitting Crush

When quitting Crush, you'll see a splash screen with a hind on how to quickly continue from the session you left.

Bash tool syntax highlighting

When displaying what Crush is running using the Bash tool, the shell command will now have syntax highlighting. It's a small addition, but definitely improves legibility.

Moo :cow:

ctrl+end to jump to bottom + follow

If you want to quickly jump to the bottom of the chat, you can now just press ctrl+end. This will also ensure Crush will follow the chat as new messages arrive.

MCP improvements

We enhanced things to make it more stable and fix a couple of edge-case bugs.

That's all for today. See you in the next release! Charm 💌

crush.html:
It’s Time for a Bugfix Throwdown

This release is all about stability and quality of life with a buncha fixes around MCP, server-client, and odds and ends. Here's what’s inside:

  • UX: Typing clear in the command will match Summarize; thanks, @joestump!
  • LSP: @piakdev fixed a case where LSP could panic
  • MCP: Slow loading MCPs could block messages from being sent: we reduce default timeout
  • Server-Client: MCP OAuth didn't work in server-client mode; now it does
  • Server-Client: Clients in the same workspace could kill each other: not anymore
  • Server-Client: When the server is running over TCP keystrokes no longer hit the server and slow everything down
  • Hyper: Added various small improvements for better UX

Thanks for using Crush. Have good weekend! Charm 💌

crush.title: Crush v0.88.0
crush.summary: .crushrc is here! Hey! Hope everybody had a great week. We were pretty productive at Charm and we're releasing some cool stuff today. Bash configuration! (.crushrc) Yep, .crushrc has come! You existing JSON config still works, but we just started migrating to…
crush.html:
.crushrc is here!

Hey! Hope everybody had a great week. We were pretty productive at Charm and we're releasing some cool stuff today.

Bash configuration! (.crushrc)

Yep, .crushrc has come! You existing JSON config still works, but we just started migrating to something a lot more flexible!

An example on why this is cool: if you manage Crush config in a dotfiles repo, you can still have machine-specific overrides by using source to call a separate file that will be in your .gitignore. I'm sure there are many other use cases.

To read the full documentation on this, read this document.

See a snipped so you have an idea on how it looks:

# Add Ollama.
provider add ollama --type ollama --base-url "http://localhost:11434/v1"

# Register a model on Ollama.
model add ollama/llama3.3 --name "Llama 3.3" --context-window 128000

# Auto-approve some tools.
permissions allow view edit

# Add an MCP server
mcp add github \
  --type http \
  --url "https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/" \
  --header Authorization "Bearer $GITHUB_TOKEN"

# Load some extra config
source "$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/squid-config.sh"

# Change config based on the machine you're on.
if [[ $HOSTNAME == "babysquid" ]]; then
    option skill-path "$HOME/squid-skills"
fi

Want to give feedback? Join the #crush channel on Discord.

Better AWS Bedrock SSO support

@jan-xyz did a great job bringing this one to life!

When using AWS Bedrock via SSO, tokens expire with time and need to be refreshed. Crush now has a proper configuration and UX for authenticating, and it will appear whenever tokens need to be refreshed.

To read more about it, see #2886.

More reliable Agent Fetch

@sven2718 contributed with better retries in searches when they don't work in the first try. Searches will be more reliable now, specially when doing many in a short period of time.

Fix for Fable 5

@sven2718 also contributed with a fix for Fable 5. When Anthropic decides to reject your prompt for security reasons, we'll now a proper error message in Crush. Before, Crush would just stop without giving context on why.

Crush now compiles on IlluminOS

Never heard of IllumiOS? Neither none of us at Charm, but @timotheosh adjusted the code to ensure it compiles there now!

Go compiles to many environments, and it's always fun to see Crush working on more operating systems! By the way, do you know you can use Crush on Android? :robot:

Enhanced MCP OAuth

In the last release, we shipped support for OAuth authentication for MCPs.

@BrunoKrugel did a few fixes to make more MCPs that require OAuth work as expected.

Agentic fixes

Quite a few fixes were made to Crush as an agent as well. Some of these were made on Fantasy and brought to Crush.

New Hyper models

Not less important, we keep bringing updates to Hyper, which is more stable than ever and has Minimax M3 and Qwen3.7-Flash avalable now.

A lot happened this week! We hope you enjoy, and Keep Crushing :tm:! Charm

crush.html:
MCP OAuth, performance and more

Happy Friday everybody!

We're releasing some nice features for you so you can enjoy your weekend vibecoding. (Or not, stay outside :sun_with_face: and return to Crush on Monday! :smiley:).

MCP OAuth

That's it, it's finally here! Some of you have been asking for this for long.

This is required for some MCPs to work. Want to know to it set it up? Refer to this section into the README.

Thank @joestump and his agent @joestump-agent for this contribution. And of course, our favorite @taciturnaxolotl also helped.

Claude Channels MCP extension

@joestump (and his agent) also added an initial implementation to support the Claude Channels MCP extension, which means MCPs can now send notifications to Crush when certain events happen.

Give this a try if you're interested, and let us know how well it works for you.

Restored MCP prompts

MCP prompts were unintentionally disabled in a previous release, but they were now added back!

LSP performance boost

Another cool contrib was made by @TheJhyeFactor, who vastly improved the CPU and memory usage on handling LSP servers in large repositories!

See #3370 for a more in-depth explanation of the optimizations.

Bang mode performance boost

@TheJhyeFactor also improved performance of output streaming when running command in bang mode.

Check #3381 to see some benchmarking.

/etc/crush/crush.json

You read it right! Thank to @Muttaqin86 you can now have a system-wide Crush configuration on /etc/crush/crush.json.

The motivation for this was improving compatibility with NixOS.

Fixed Copilot + GPT-5.6

All three GPT-5.6 models (Sol, Terra and Luna) are now fixed when running via GitHub Copilot. Kudos to @nghiant03 for this!

That was a lot, but it's really fun to how much the community is enganged with Crush dev.

Keep Crushing! :tm: Charm

crush.summary: LSP tools, scrollable sidebar, removable attachments + more Hey all. We're starting the week in style by shipping some LSP stuff and more goodies. Brand new LSP tools These new LSP tools will allow the model to more accurately do some refactors: lsp_rename -…
crush.html:
LSP tools, scrollable sidebar, removable attachments + more

Hey all. We're starting the week in style by shipping some LSP stuff and more goodies.

Brand new LSP tools

These new LSP tools will allow the model to more accurately do some refactors:

  • lsp_rename - Rename a symbol and all its references in the project
  • lsp_replace_symbol - Replace, insert before/after, or delete an entire function/method/class by name

If something doesn't work as expected by the LSP, don't worry. We'll report an error to the model so it can fallback to using the edit tool.

Scrollable sidebar

This one is pretty cool. Got out-of-space in your sidebar? Don't worry, you can scroll its content now!

Keyboard:

  • When focused on the chat view: l or right arrow focuses on the sidebar
  • j/k or up/down arrow scrolls up and down
  • g scrolls to top shift+g scrolls to the bottom
  • h or left arrow focuses back on the chat view
  • tab always returns focus to the editor

Removable attachments

It's now possible to remove attachments with your mouse! Just click on the X button:

Better Hyper OAuth

When authentication on Charm Hyper ™️ or GitHub Copilot you can now press u to copy the URL. This is needed for certain scenarios, like when using Crush over SSH, where it might not be possible to open the browser automatically.

Quit dialog hint

When rendering the quit dialog, we're now showing an hint that it's possible to skip the confirmation completely by simple pressing ctrl+c twice.

Agent fixes

  • Reasoning effort level none is now working for Baseten models
  • Thinking blocks are now rendering for MiniMax M3 via OpenCode (thanks @marifcelik)

That's all for today. Keep crushing! Charm

crush.html:
If you have questions, we have answers

This release brings us a question tool (at last!) plus a bunch of bugfixes and niceties. Let's go!

The Question Tool

So! Crush now ships with a first class question tool, useful for when LLMs wanna grill you. The question tool comes in many forms, like single choice, multiple choice, free form text, and yes/no. Questions can be ganged together to build a form, too.

What’s that you say? “Does it have mouse support?” Why, yes it does.

What is this sorcery? Only @taciturnaxolotl knows. He solo’d this whole feature exclusively with open source models on Hyper.

Hurry up and wait

Ever put an LLM to work, only to forget about it and come back and wonder how long it's been cranking? @andrinoff sure did. Wonder no more.

And so much more

Like Prince in the 80s, @taciturnaxolotl continued his tour of awesomeness alongside @andreynering to make Crush better under the hood too:

  • Fixed: crush auth now works outside of client/server mode
  • New: Crush now auto retries auth under the hood when it fails
  • Improved: dialogues now render great on tiny screens
  • Perf: scrollbar optimizations for faster rendering
  • Perf: memoized markdown renderer for faster rendering
  • Perf: short circuit jq builtin operations if the turn was canceled before it started
  • Yay! OpenAI merged our PR upstream so we're back off our fork

Buckle up, we have a bunch more coming.

xoxo, Charm 💘

crush.html:
If you like caching and coding on your Android, you’ll love Crush v0.84.0

This is a mini release with two little niceties:

Cachemaxxing

Crush now sends the fabled x-session-affinity header (and x-session-id) in its requests. Supporting providers can pick the header up, pin the session to a given replica, and go cache wild. The session header is a hash with no personally identifiable information, of course.

Fixed: Termux

If you’re a nerd with an Android, you probably use Termux, the hot Android terminal emulator. If you’re a cool nerd, you probably want to use Crush on an Android and are annoyed that it was broken. Thanks to @Ricardo-M-L, Crush now works on Android again.

Hope you're having a great summer! Unless you're in South America, Central America, the Southern part of Mexico, parts of Africa or Australia, in which case…hope you're enjoying the Winter!

xoxo, Charm 🍔

crush.html:
General fixes

Hello. This small patch includes some varied fixes.

Better chat scroll

On some rare occasions, the chat could stop scrolling automatically to the bottom as the model works. We made some changes to make this more reliable!

General agent fixes

There were a few fixes here and there making the agent behave better. We made thinking on/off and reasoning levels behave better for providers like Alibaba and Baseten, for example.

We are finally mentioning Hyper on README, which are our favourite inference service for Crush.

See ya!

This is it, the chat just got a scrollbar! This should make your life easier on navigation long session. You can now see exactly where you are when scrolling.

It's possible to adjust the behavior with a setting: options.tui.scrollbar.

  • default (hides after 2 seconds)
  • always
  • never
{
  "options": {
    "tui": {
      "scrollbar": "default" // default, always, never
    }
  }
}

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c0c0f888-78d4-4457-ae32-eb1a2dd5f575

Herdr Support

Have you been wanting to use herdr.dev for all your agent management needs? Well now its even better! @taciturnaxolotl merged support for agent status signaling so now herdr can pick up on the status of crush and send you notifications when it is blocked or finished!

Lower CPU usage

Crush could use too much CPU when streaming thinking traces and showing them for you. @taciturnaxolotl worked through an optimization and that's now fixed!

Fix possible deadlock on startup

If you happen to have a model ID in your config that does not exist anymore (was removed from the providers), Crush could lock when booting and not start at all. This bug was addressed.

Images and your session

This is another fix to prevent your session from breaking when you switch to a non-vision model but your session already has images. We're going to skip the images so your session keep working.

That's all! Charm

crush.summary: The Ol’ Thursday Patch Hi all! It's patch time, and time for some bonus features. Let's go! Fixin’ broken tool calls Occasionally a model will opt to do a tool call with invalid arguments (invalid JSON), the session was just breaking, and even new prompts…
crush.html:
The Ol’ Thursday Patch

Hi all! It's patch time, and time for some bonus features. Let's go!

Fixin’ broken tool calls

Occasionally a model will opt to do a tool call with invalid arguments (invalid JSON), the session was just breaking, and even new prompts wouldn't anymore. We're now validating the issue and reporting it as an error to the model so it can correct itself. Of course, we also fixed the associated bug in Crush so sessions will no longer break.

Local models: auto-detectin’ context windows

Who loves local models? Now, Crush will now automatically detect models context windows with you add an endpoint for llamacpp, omlx, lmstudio, litellm, and ollama. Prior to this it was mis-setting window sizes to zero.

Config: harder, faster, stronger

Okay maybe not harder. But config in Crush is definitely faster and stronger.

We refactored on the so it's way more performant and safe for big, long configs where there are many providers, models, and so on. This also means that the model picker dialog will load faster too! We also added some safeguards to prevent race conditions when multiple Crush instances try to update the config at the same time.

You look great

That's all for today! Keep crushing it, everyone. :cupid:

crush.html:
More Bang Mode™ improvements

This morning we released the new Bang Mode. For this release, we did a couple small fixes and enhancements to it:

  • We tweaked the font colors to make it more legible;
  • A long-running command will now show immediately and stream output as the command runs;
  • Session name generation is fixed for sessions started with a command.

Agent bug fixes

We made a few bug fixes to Fantasy to make Crush behave better with certains providers and models.

  • The tool not found error now print the list of available tool. This is targeting certain models like Kimi that sometimes can get lost and call tools that doesn't exist;
  • Fixes potential tool call errors with the GLM family via Fireworks;
  • Fixed some GPT models via Azure (thanks @dustinlagoy);
  • Fixes Gemini via VertexAI (thanks @eswar-7116);
  • Fixed tool calls sometimes not working properly for local models.

Have a great weekend and keep crushing! :rocket: The Charm Team

crush.summary: Bang Bang! We're ending the week in style with one awesome feature you've been asking for and one awesome feature you didn’t! Let’s go! Bang Mode “What’s bang mode?" you ask. Why it’s simply a nice way to let you run Bash commands directly in a session. It’s…
crush.html:
Bang Bang!

We're ending the week in style with one awesome feature you've been asking for and one awesome feature you didn’t! Let’s go!

Bang Mode

“What’s bang mode?" you ask. Why it’s simply a nice way to let you run Bash commands directly in a session. It’s great for taking advantage of the shell without leaving Crush. To enter bang mode, just type a !. To exit, hit backspace.

Of course, the best thing about bang mode is that the model can also see the out, so if you run a command you can then chat with the model about it.

Special thanks to @taigrr for the initial implementation to @taciturnaxolotl for turning it up several notches, with some suggestions from @nobilelucifero. Enjoy and let us know if you have of any feedback!

Local Model Auto-Discovery

@taciturnaxolotl loves local models. What he did not love was manually adding them to the Crush, and like a true open source devotee, and he took matters into his own hands. Crush can now auto-discover local models for a given endpoint so you don't have to declare them manually.

{
   // Look Ma, no manual model definitions!
  "providers": {
    "ollama": {
      "name": "Ollama",
      "base_url": "http://localhost:11434/v1/",
      "type": "ollama"
    }
  }
}

This works for MLX, LMStudio, LiteLLM and Ollama. More info in the README.

(Is cool or what? Someone get @taciturnaxolotl a Strix Halo!)

The clipboard: now clipper than ever

We improved the way the clipboard works in Crush big time, particularly in X11 and Wayland: xclip and xsel are no longer required! You can also paste TIFFs (WeChat users, rejoice!) and super+v (yes, ⌘+v, macOS people) will also now paste images.

Fireworks

By popular demand Crush now supports a new provider: Fireworks! Grab your API key, choose a model on Fireworks and go to town.

Thanks

As always keep the good vibes coming, and keep crushing It!

The Charm™ Team

crush.title: Crush v0.77.0
crush.summary: Global context, better commit messages…and you It's been a bit! There’s lots of good stuff in this release, so let’s get right to it. Global context Want Crush to always call you Shirley? Or maybe you want it to default to Jujutsu? This is now a piece of cake…
crush.html:
Global context, better commit messages…and you

It's been a bit! There’s lots of good stuff in this release, so let’s get right to it.

Global context

Want Crush to always call you Shirley? Or maybe you want it to default to Jujutsu? This is now a piece of cake with user-level context files thanks to @Amolith.

If you create ~/.config/AGENTS.md or ~/.config/crush/CRUSH.md, Crush will reference it on session start just like your usual project-level AGENTS.md and CRUSH.md. Nice!

Crashes? Not on Kieran’s watch.

Kieran, otherwise known as @taciturnaxolotl, is fast. Really fast. The other day Crush crashed for him, he honed in on two bugs in Lip Gloss and Glamour, and patched them before we could say, "Don’t panic!" Thanks, Kieran!

Better commit messages and PR descriptions

You know what drives us crazy? When LLMs write overly-technical commit messages and PR descriptions that reference obscure parts of the code. Commit messages and PRs should be understandable to readers unfamiliar with the codebase.

This PR improves the system prompt so LLMs author clearer, more understandable commit messages for human beings.

Named hooks

Thanks to contributor @BrunoKrugel, you can now name your hooks, making them easier to identify in the CLI.

{
  "hooks": {
    "PreToolUse": [
      {
        "name": "Mr. Hot Hook",
        "matcher": "bash",
        "command": "./hooks/my-hot-hook.sh",
      },
    ],
  },
}

For more info see https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/pull/2778.

Client-server: socket fixes

Client-server mode isn’t quite ready for prime time yet, but many of us are using it day-to-day regardless. One of the coolest things about client server mode is that it runs over unix domain sockets (which absolutely rock) and named pipes on Windows. This release fixes two bugs around that:

  • Stale sockets are now cleaned up on startup, allowing Crush to run properly
  • On unix systems sockets now live in the places they actually belong: $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR on Linux and $TMPDIR on macOS, rather than /tmp.

Try out client-server mode with CRUSH_CLIENT_SERVER=1.

See u soon

Thanks for all the positive feedback about Crush. We ❤️ you!

Charm

crush.html:
Friday patch

Shipping a couple small things for those who will keep crushing during the weekend.

Permissions UX fix

We made a change to avoid accidental interactions when the permission dialog shows. Crush will now ignore key presses up to 350ms after the dialog is shown. This will prevent you from accepting or denying something by mistake when you're typing when the dialog appears.

crush models fix

crush models will not shown all models, and not only the configured ones.

More client-server

And more and more fixes for the experimental client-server architecture are merged. This will power Crush to do really nice things once finished!

That's for this week. Enjoy your weekend! Charm ✨

crush.html:
Bug fixin'

This is a maintenance release which fixes a couple small bugs.

Hyper OAuth fix

We fixed a bug where the Hyper OAuth dialog could appear mid-session, in case you had multiple Crush sessions that attempted to refresh the access token at the very same time.

Fixed rare startup bug

This is a rare edge-case, but we fixed a bug that could prevent Crush from starting in case it can't find a default large or small model for a provider, due to it being removed.

That's all for today. Stay tuned! 📺

crush.html:
More client-server, better notifications, and more

Bringing you a few enhancements and bug fixes. Let's check them out!

Client-server

The experiment client-server architecture got even more fixes.

Want to test? Set CRUSH_CLIENT_SERVER=1.

Better notifications

We updated our notifications to be smarter. They will now work when using Crush over SSH, and support for more platforms were improved as well.

Copilot fixes

A couple more models that require the Responses API will now use them and work again. This includes GPT 5.4 and GPT 5.5.

Bedrock fixes

A couple more improvements were made to AWS Bedrock, in particular regarding Bedrock Europe and the support for authentication via aws login.

See you in the next release! Charm

crush.summary: Follow-up to Bedrock Last Friday, we shipped some changes for Bedrock to make it work by default for most users. Before that release, your AWS_REGION or AWS_DEFAULT_REGION could instruct Crush to try to reach Bedrock at a different region, and it could not…
crush.html:
Follow-up to Bedrock

Last Friday, we shipped some changes for Bedrock to make it work by default for most users.

Before that release, your AWS_REGION or AWS_DEFAULT_REGION could instruct Crush to try to reach Bedrock at a different region, and it could not work at all because most models are only available in very few regions. Because it was not clear why Crush was not working for Bedrock, this could be confusing to users. We then enforced us-east-1 for region because that one should work for everyone.

Bedrock Europe 🇪🇺

Since then, a few of you reached out telling us that models are also available on eu-west-1, and some users in Europe might prefer or need (due to employer restrictions) to use an European region.

Starting on this release, you'll see two providers if you search for "bedrock":

  • Bedrock US: will use us-east-1
  • Bedrock Europe: will use eu-west-1

That's all for today. Stay tuned for the next releases!

crush.html:
QoL Release

Hey all! Some of you in the US 🇺🇸 are enjoying a Holiday, but we're still here shipping stuff.

Today's release ships some Quality of Life :tm: improvements.

Better user-invocable skill commands

Skills can have user-invocable commands, and we'll now also show a description if available. Easier to see what's that command about.

Scrollbar in the sessions list

In the last released we added a scrollbar to the models list dialog. The same very scrollbar is not also in the sessions list dialog. It's a small addition, but really help navigating the list.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e1cbab14-e3bc-4d91-881a-b50f4caed273

TODO expanded by default

The TODO list will be render expanded by default, unless your terminal height is too short. This is useful to see what's happening as the model works.

Want to toggle it? Just press ctrl+t to open or close it.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/62e7c7ee-41e9-43de-8a41-d926d4bbefbe

ctrl+y to toggle YOLO

Having to open the command palette to enable or disable YOLO can be inconvenint. You can now do that by just pressing ctrl+y.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0b0f5794-72ee-4690-9403-7d7e48609563

That's all for today. Charm :cupid:

crush.html:
Small feats, fixes, Bedrock and more

We have quite a good number of things for a Friday. Let's take a quick look at them!

Scrollbar

The model list now got a scrollbar, so you can see how long the list is and where you are on it. It's a small addition, but nice and useful.

Token usage

Some providers do not report how many tokens were used in a request. In these cases, Crush wasn't showing the token usage or estimated cost in the sidebar.

@taoeffect added token and cost estimation when the provider doesn't report this. Now you'll have an idea on how fast you're burning tokens.

Bedrock

We made some changes to avoid some confusing when using AWS Bedrock.

Before, Crush was using whichever region you had set on AWS_REGION or AWS_DEFAULT_REGION variables. The problem is that most region have few models available, so you could be unable to use them if you had a different region set.

We're always using the us-east-1 region, which have all models available. This should make Crush work out-of-the-box with Bedrock without specific local region configuration.

If you have any feedback on Crush for Bedrock, reach out on our Discord or Slack communities.

Stream fixes

@ethanndickson contributed with two fixes on Fantasy that should fix some errors related to streaming.

Permission prompts

We tightned up permission prompts a bit to improve security, when the model wants to run Bash comments with pipes, redirection, etc. Crush will now always ask for permission in these cases.

Reasoning effort level fix

We fixed a bug to ensure Crush won't ever send a reasoning effort level when the model doesn't supports it. This should fix potential errors for a couple providers.

More client-server

More fixes to the experimental client-server architecture were merged.

You can opt-in to this mode with export CRUSH_CLIENT_SERVER=1.

That's all

There were more small fixes and improvements, but the list above is a good summary.

Enjoy your weekend (and Holiday for Americans) and see you next week! Charm :sparklers:

crush.html:
Alibaba, Better Retries, and Client-Server

We're starting the week with some good stuff. Let's check them out!

New Provider: Alibaba

A new provider is available: Alibaba! Just open the model picker with ctrl+m, search for Alibaba and paste your API key. Alternatively, you can set $ALIBABA_SINGAPORE_API_KEY.

Alibaba has a few regions, but we're starting with the main one: Singapore as the hot new models are available there, like the newer Qwens.

Better Retries

Thanks to @processtrader, Crush is now a bit smarter on retries. Instead of just retrying on specific error codes (400, 500, etc), Crush will now also retry on network errors (in case you're offline for a second, or a DNS query failed, etc).

Hardening Client-Server Mode

Crush has an experimental/client server mode which can be used to extend Crush, operate more effectively with multiple sessions, and connect to remote Crush instances.

We’re using client/server more and more internally, so it's time to harden it. This release fixes some bugs that were blocking us from using it day to day.

If you want to try out client/server mode, Crush has an experimental client-server architecture refactor happening, currently available via:

export CRUSH_CLIENT_SERVER=1

That's it for today. Stay tuned for more soon! Charm :cupid:

zed.title: Zed v1.26.2
zed.summary: This week's release includes Pyrefly as an optional built-in Python language server, the ability to expand and inspect nested variable values directly in debugger hovers, and DWARF debugging for WebAssembly sources in the JavaScript debugger. Features AI…
zed.html:
This week's release includes Pyrefly as an optional built-in Python language server, the ability to expand and inspect nested variable values directly in debugger hovers, and DWARF debugging for WebAssembly sources in the JavaScript debugger.

Features

AI
  • Improved ACP configuration defaults to apply only to new conversations, preserving session settings when reopening existing conversations. (#65850)
  • Improved fuzzy searching in agent model and configuration option pickers for Zed Agent and third-party ACP agents, while keeping search preparation off the UI thread. (#64147; thanks JacobNWolf)
  • Improved OpenCode compatibility when replaying DeepSeek reasoning and disabling thinking for Google models. (#65922)
  • Improved thinking controls to explain when thinking cannot be disabled at the selected effort level. (#62480)
Debugger
  • Added DWARF debugging to the JavaScript debugger to support debugging WebAssembly sources. (#65371; thanks SGumbles)
  • Improved debugger hovers with an expandable, keyboard-accessible variable tree. (#53198; thanks Tortes)
Languages
  • Added Pyrefly as an optional built-in Python language server, available when enabled in the Python language_servers setting. (#44262; thanks grievejia)
  • Improved restarting language servers after stopping them with the LSP button. (#65387)
  • Improved SQL syntax highlighting in Rust sql! string literals. (#58778; thanks kuskhan)
Remote Development
  • Improved SSH reconnections by starting the resync timeout only after the handshake completes. (#65457; thanks Huliiiiii)
macOS
  • Added support for the Display P3 color space on macOS with the use_display_p3 setting. (#64394; thanks MDalstrom)
Other
  • Added an extension option to project_panel.sort_order to group files by extension. (#65776; thanks Carnage725)
  • Improved fuzzy search ranking in the File Finder. (#59224; thanks feitreim)

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed discarding unstaged changes in the Git Panel also discarding staged changes. (#65559; thanks stezu)
  • Fixed hangs when restoring agent threads with subagents. (#65177)
  • Fixed a crash in the Agent Panel when mentioning a file whose name contains a line break, and improved how those mentions display line breaks. (#65693)
  • Fixed a bug where cancelling the save-changes prompt while removing a project from the sidebar still removed it from the recent projects list. (#65683; thanks mateioprea)
  • Fixed agent authentication overwriting drafts. (#65844)
  • Fixed agent configuration defaults being saved before acceptance or ignoring the agent's returned value. (#65849)
  • Fixed duplicated thinking text from OpenAI-compatible providers that send both reasoning and reasoning_content. (#65926)
  • Fixed file links with line numbers failing to open WSL files when using Zed on Windows. (#66089; thanks buvidk1234)
  • Fixed file icons not appearing for stem-based filename variants. (#51891; thanks bryanpth)
  • Fixed Google AI invalid API keys being classified as invalid requests instead of authentication errors. (#65885)
  • Fixed IME composition text not being underlined in single-line inputs and editors with diagnostics turned off. (#65610; thanks Sha1rholder)
  • Fixed issues detecting local and remote environment variables when using PowerShell (pwsh). (#66097)
  • Fixed JSON completion ordering for enum values in settings.json. (#65589; thanks ragen1337)
  • Fixed Markdown preview tabs for files with the same name not showing their directory. (#65736; thanks gitKashish)
  • Fixed Mistral Large 4 responses failing when used through an OpenAI-compatible provider. (#65915)
  • Fixed OpenCode requests failing for Claude models that use adaptive thinking block binding. (#65925)
  • Fixed pasting a screenshot into the Agent Panel or inline assistant inserting the image twice or alongside its temporary file path. (#65626; thanks qystishere)
  • Fixed queued messages in the Agent Panel becoming unreadable when the panel was narrow. (#65638; thanks 0froq)
  • Fixed Rust task and debugger variables for files outside Cargo projects. (#65684; thanks shoyann)
  • Fixed touchscreen scrolling using the previous swipe's axis when a new touch interrupts momentum scrolling. (#64239; thanks huacnlee)
  • Fixed trusting projects on remote Windows machines from Unix systems. (#63102; thanks lingyaochu)

zed.title: Zed v1.25.2
zed.summary: This week's release includes smaller Zed binaries across macOS, Windows, and Linux, the ability to apply inlay hint text edits by double-clicking, context compaction and session notices for external agents, and new GPT-6 Astra, Claude Fable 5.1, and Claude…
zed.html:
This week's release includes smaller Zed binaries across macOS, Windows, and Linux, the ability to apply inlay hint text edits by double-clicking, context compaction and session notices for external agents, and new GPT-6 Astra, Claude Fable 5.1, and Claude Opus 5.5 models on Amazon Bedrock.

Features

AI
  • Added GPT-6 Astra, Claude Fable 5.1, and Claude Opus 5.5 to the Amazon Bedrock provider. (#64201, #64685; thanks IbrahimKhan12 and alexandergunnarson)
  • Enabled session notices and context compaction for external agents using ACP. (#65414)
Git
  • Improved the branch picker to make clear that deleting a remote-tracking branch only removes the local ref, and removed the force delete option for remote-tracking branches, since it had no effect. (#61793; thanks lld4n)
Languages
  • Added support for applying inlay hint text edits by double-clicking a hint, or by running editor: accept inlay hint with the cursor at the hint. (#64789)
  • Added HTML syntax highlighting for svg, mathml and raw tagged templates, and CSS syntax highlighting for template literals in css({ ... }) objects, in JavaScript and TypeScript. (#65688)
Remote Development
  • Improved SSH remote connection time by detecting the remote shell, platform, and OS version in one command instead of three, which helps most when connecting from Windows. (#65065; thanks Huliiiiii)
Other
  • Added automatic unfolding of folded sections when jumping to a location via go to line, go to definition/declaration/implementation/type definition, symbol navigation, the outline and project symbol pickers, multibuffer location results, and navigation history. (#65217; thanks henne90gen)
  • Added an "Open SVG Preview" option to the Project Panel's context menu for SVG files. (#65539; thanks skmanoj322)
  • Added the tab_switcher.show_file_preview setting, which controls whether files are previewed in the editor while cycling through the tab switcher (defaults to true). (#56235; thanks sebascadpi)
  • Improved the tab switcher so it no longer changes selection on mouse hover and no longer delays showing its popover; you can still click entries to switch tabs. (#65546)
  • Improved startup time when restoring hundreds of editor selections. (#65171)
  • Improved startup time when using custom icon themes. (#65173)
  • Reduced Zed's binary size by about 33% on macOS, 28% on Windows, and 7% on Linux. (#65168)

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed a bug where environment variables, including secrets, passed to external agents and MCP servers in remote projects were visible in the local machine's process list. (#65174)
  • Fixed prompts to external agents being slow to send, or never sending, because of unneeded Git checkpoints. (#65304)
  • Fixed the remote server failing to start when connecting to a Windows host over SSH. (#55292; thanks sergio-u)
  • Fixed ctrl-o and ctrl-i in Vim mode not navigating back and forward when a Markdown preview was focused. (#65299; thanks gitKashish)
  • Fixed a bug where archiving an agent thread did nothing and kept a CPU core busy when the thread's linked worktree folder had been deleted. (#65578)
  • Fixed a bug where case conversion and other text transformation commands duplicated the word when multiple cursors were inside it. (#65291; thanks gitKashish)
  • Fixed a bug where navigating back skipped a Markdown preview tab after switching to another file. (#65299; thanks gitKashish)
  • Fixed a bug where notification sounds could stop playing after an audio output error, and on Linux an audio thread could keep using a full CPU core until Zed restarted. (#65158)
  • Fixed a bug where the Git Panel's commit editor buttons changed opacity when hovering over empty space. (#65448; thanks shuvroroy)
  • Fixed a bug where the Project Panel's "Open Markdown Preview" option did not appear for files opened on their own (e.g. zed README.md). (#65539; thanks skmanoj322)
  • Fixed a bug where the Settings UI sidebar did not highlight the subsection being scrolled through, including the last short subsections of a page. (#65172; thanks mayurathavale18)
  • Fixed a visual artifact at the corners of scrollable code blocks when hovered. (#64978)
  • Fixed blurred window backgrounds not blurring on macOS 27. (#65361; thanks biw)
  • Fixed edit predictions showing an unlimited allowance and available controls when a team organization with no active subscription was selected. (#65301)
  • Fixed external agents' first updates in a new thread sometimes being dropped, and agent error output being missing when an agent exited during startup. (#65339)
  • Fixed extra space between the scrollbar and the header of terminals in the Agent Panel. (#65358; thanks chrisdrackett)
  • Fixed Gemini models failing with an error after a tool call returned an image. (#65576)
  • Fixed hover popovers flickering or closing too early on mouse movement with language servers that omit range information. (#64032; thanks daydalek)
  • Fixed images inside center- or right-aligned HTML blocks rendering left-aligned in Markdown Preview. (#63166; thanks pray3m)
  • Fixed OpenAI-compatible edit predictions failing on servers that limit stop sequences to 4. (#65360; thanks mischah)
  • Fixed search not working in the debugger's terminal, opened with cmd-f (macOS) or ctrl-shift-f (Linux/Windows). (#56863; thanks iamsushank)

zed.html:
This week's release includes Git tag creation, the ability to drag Terminal tabs into the Agent Panel, and pre-filling of the File Finder's search query with text selected in the editor or terminal.

Features

AI
  • Improved Agent Panel terminal support by allowing Terminal tabs to be dragged into it. (#60582; thanks cppcoffee)
  • Improved custom Amazon Bedrock model support with configurable tool use, images, and thinking. (#64953; thanks mpyuglgwkxcmodyrpo)
  • Improved memory and CPU usage while the agent responds in long threads. (#65244)
Git
  • Added a git: create tag at head command and a Create Tag… context menu action in Git history and Git Graph to create local tags on commits. Tags are not pushed automatically. (#61973, #65194; thanks cppcoffee)
  • Added gitiles as a Git hosting provider for Gitiles/Gerrit deployments, enabling permalinks and navigation from the Git blame diff view. (#63996; thanks JonathanBerkeley)
  • Added a side-by-side view for directory diffs opened with zed --diff. (#64967; thanks ian-h-chamberlain)
  • Added file counts to section headers in the Git Panel. (#65028; thanks mansoorkhan96)
  • Added self-hosted Gerrit repositories as a provider for permalinks. (#53832; thanks starsep)
  • Improved the Git Panel with a collapsible commit message editor, configurable with git_panel.commit_editor, and the Git Graph with collapsible commit details. (#63236; thanks mulhamna)
  • Improved Git Graph readability by moving refs from the description column into the graph. (#59839; thanks RemcoSmitsDev)
  • Improved Git Panel file actions for multiple selected files. (#64640; thanks Acd-kk)
Debugger
  • Improved the debugger variables view with distinct colors for values based on their type, such as integers and strings. (#64111; thanks syormon)
Languages
  • Added a Show Source option to the Markdown preview tab context menu. (#65081; thanks joshkent94)
  • Added a Go package-level test gutter button next to package declarations. (#56699; thanks cppcoffee)
  • Added support for language-server extensions to configure which language servers are enabled by default in extension.toml. See the extension documentation. (#65030)
  • Added markdown_preview.heading_font_weight to configure the font weight of headings in the Markdown preview. (#64421; thanks dremnik)
  • Added the mermaid_font_family setting to configure the font used in Mermaid diagrams. (#63430; thanks Sha1rholder)
  • Improved the column filter dropdown in the tabular data preview to sort values naturally (e.g., 2 before 10). (#64764; thanks HalavicH)
Remote Development
  • Improved remote server responsiveness when log or RPC response writes are blocked. (#65011; thanks Huliiiiii)
Linux
  • Reduced the Linux release binary size by about 23% on x86_64. (#65169)
macOS
  • Improved how Finder groups Zed on macOS by identifying it as a developer tool. (#65130; thanks kennyheard)
Other
  • Added an extension_suggestions setting to turn off extension suggestions. (#65109; thanks audinue)
  • Improved the File Finder to pre-fill its query with text selected in the editor or terminal. Disable this with file_finder.prefill_query_from_selection. (#64946; thanks AbyssWaIker)
  • Improved multi-cursor editing performance. (#64409; thanks Rani367)
  • Improved project search speed and memory usage over misclassified binary files. (#64549)
  • Improved the Extensions view so installed extensions appear even while offline or when the remote list is incomplete. (#64766)
  • Improved the font family pickers in the settings window to render each option in its own font as a preview. (#64199; thanks mizanisoffline)
  • Improved Zed startup time. (#65170)

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed .env files being treated as shell scripts and triggering shellcheck warnings. They now use the Env language. (#64242; thanks pleahmacaka)
  • Fixed a crash when editing a buffer while an inlay-hint request was pending. (#65193)
  • Fixed a crash when syntax parsing requested bytes inside a multibyte character. (#65273)
  • Fixed a ty language server panic when opening a Python file as a single-file project. (#60753; thanks MostlyKIGuess)
  • Fixed ACP session title clearing and prevented programmatic title updates from being saved as user renames. (#65195)
  • Fixed ChatGPT Subscription models disappearing when the model catalog takes longer than 5 seconds to load. (#64925; thanks dualfroz)
  • Fixed Command-clicking a symbol whose name matches its file name doing nothing. (#64892; thanks skmanoj322)
  • Fixed crashes on tab-indented code blocks. (#65406)
  • Fixed emoji, symbol, and non-Latin fonts rendering as empty boxes on Linux after being used as a font fallback. (#65269)

zed.html:
This week's release includes the ability to preview JSONL and NDJSON files as tables.

Features

AI
  • Added the agent.max_idle_retained_threads setting to control how many idle agent threads remain loaded. (#64547; thanks hazicy)
  • Improved Google AI error messages and added automatic retries when a model was overloaded. (#64865)
  • Improved plan updates from ACP agents, including panel refreshes after status changes. (#64884)
  • Improved the Agent Panel error shown when a Zed sign-in expired. (#64754)
  • Improved visibility of keyboard-selected agent conversations in the Threads Sidebar. (#63922; thanks jaklyk2103)
Git
  • Added a folder-specific context menu in the Git Panel's tree view. (#59853; thanks Sondeyy)
Languages
  • Added JSONL and NDJSON support to the tabular data preview. Open previews alongside the source with cmd-k v (macOS) or ctrl-k v (Linux/Windows). (#64471; thanks unshDee)
  • Added extension installation suggestions for many more languages when opening unsupported files. (#63211; thanks haolamnm)
  • Added support for rewrapping text in Typst files. (#64858; thanks AdinAck)
Remote Development
  • Added support for terminal.shell in remote sessions. (#61451; thanks quinn)
Other

  • Added a soft_wrap_indent setting ("none", "same", "extra_one", "extra_two") to configure indentation for soft-wrapped continuation lines. (#63468; thanks arusahni)
  • Improved responsiveness when watching paths on slow or unresponsive filesystems. (#63410; thanks RemcoSmitsDev)
  • Improved editor: select next and editor: select previous to respect the buffer search whole-word option. (#64137; thanks yawnnn)

Bug Fixes

  • Debugger: Fixed "Rerun last debug scenario" not running the last scheduled scenario. (#64856; thanks MeiramSh)
  • Fixed a crash on Windows when reading a stored credential that has no username. (#64735)
  • Fixed a crash when pasting multiple selections at the end of a file in Vim mode. (#64876)
  • Fixed a crash when typing the start of a multi-key binding at the end of a read-only file. (#64730)
  • Fixed agent notifications showing a thread's original title after the thread was renamed. (#64907; thanks IFafaa)
  • Fixed commit details and diffs waiting behind an in-progress fetch, pull, or push before opening. (#64720; thanks azeemshaik025)
  • Fixed external-agent sessions remaining loaded after their conversation was closed during loading. (#64717)
  • Fixed images in Markdown table cells ignoring column alignment and vertical centering. (#64914; thanks dremnik)
  • Fixed issues where OpenAI model tool calls to MCP servers treated optional fields as required, causing errors. (#64920)
  • Fixed missing or outdated output in agent tool results. (#64708)

  • Fixed stale agent responses that could clear a newer prompt or show errors from an earlier send. (#64917)
  • Fixed syntax highlighting for fenced code blocks with extra text after the language name. (#64694; thanks maxmalkin)
  • Fixed the pending keybindings list showing task: spawn instead of the task name for bindings that spawn a task. (#64937; thanks frinyvonnick)
  • Fixed the Zed Cloud connection failing with UnknownIssuer behind corporate TLS-inspecting proxies whose root CA is installed in the system trust store. (#63686; thanks joepjoosten)
  • ACP: Fixed partial tool-call display updates when content referenced an unavailable terminal. (#64784)
  • Fixed a bug where inlay hints positioned past the end of a buffer could appear on its last line, and inlay hints exactly at the end of a file without a trailing newline could be hidden. (#64659; thanks HuaGu-Dragon)
  • Fixed a rare crash when hovering wrapped Markdown text on Linux. (#64672)
  • Fixed centered layout not applying when a pane was zoomed in. (#64064; thanks UdeshyaDhungana)
  • Fixed closing one LSP Logs view stopping streams used by another view or downstream client. (#61222; thanks aviatesk)
  • Fixed completion details lacking visual distinction from completion labels. (#64684; thanks GautamBytes)
  • Fixed delayed selection of the first entry when opening a context menu. (#64365)
  • Fixed entries folding when clicked in the Outline Panel. (#64736)
  • Fixed Helix buffer picker opening in the wrong pane on space b. (#64494; thanks GautamBytes)
  • Fixed hover flicker after dismissing native menus on macOS. (#64175; thanks yay)
  • Fixed incorrect selected and hover colors for threads in the Threads Sidebar. (#62597; thanks Robot-Inventor)
  • Fixed indentation corruption during multicursor editing and block indentation. (#64675
