qwen-code.title: Qwen Code v0.26.3
qwen-code.summary: Highlights Generated UI cards keep inputs and state across navigation and split views, show live views after initial calculation, and appear only for clients that can render MCP Apps. (#15611, #15787, #15720, #15790) Persistent session Workflow mode can be…
qwen-code.html:
Highlights

  • Generated UI cards keep inputs and state across navigation and split views, show live views after initial calculation, and appear only for clients that can render MCP Apps. (#15611, #15787, #15720, #15790)
  • Persistent session Workflow mode can be enabled with --workflow-mode on, /workflows mode on, SDK, or ACP, and workflow switches now reach the CLI sandbox. (#15422, #15743)
  • Tool results shrink to remaining headroom before auto-compaction, and qwen-latest-series- or qwen4 aliases are detected with 1M-token context windows. (#13599, #15758, #15762)
  • Valid XML tool calls are recovered when parameters quote other call markup, malformed blocks are isolated, and quoted examples are not dispatched. (#13579)
  • ACP and daemon clients keep rewind identity consistent across retries, cancellations, checkpoints, recordings, and notifications, while SDK frames preserve subagent identity. (#15441, #15657)
  • /autofix-pr start stops when the PR head branch has unpushed commits or uncommitted changes, preventing the watch from overwriting unseen work. (#15736)

Breaking Changes

No known breaking changes.

Complete Change List

Features
  • feat(memory): opt-in extraction cadence after a no-op run (#13571) by @yiliang114
  • Shrinks tool results to remaining headroom before auto-compaction, respecting explicit truncation settings and protected content to reduce unnecessary compaction. (#13599) by @yiliang114
  • Keeps eligible Generated UI cards alive across history navigation, session switching, and split-view changes in the same page, preserving inputs, controls, and runtime state. (#15611) by @qqqys
  • Adds persistent session Workflow mode through --workflow-mode on, /workflows mode on, SDK, and ACP controls, with saved mode shown in Ink and OpenTUI. (#15422) by @qqqys
  • Adds opt-in composerVariant simple to Web Shell, providing a compact input with a limited add menu and shared editor, attachments, and session actions. (#15663) by @samuelhsin
  • /autofix-pr start now stops if the PR head branch has unpushed commits or uncommitted changes, preventing the watch from overwriting unseen work. (#15736) by @wenshao
  • Adds administrator-driven reclamation and reuse of idle resident CSI Workspaces with cleanup verification and atomic release. (#15729) by @doudouOUC
  • OpenTUI terminals now draw the Mods band above the prompt and run Mod ui.render hooks there, matching the Ink terminal experience. (#15699) by @qqqys
  • ACP live frames, persisted replays, SDK normalization, and transcript reduction now preserve subagent identity for thoughts, messages, and tool frames. (#15657) by @yiliang114
  • Archived conversations are now managed in Settings → Archived conversations in Web Shell, keeping archive groups, filters, and lifecycle actions. (#15557) by @deggs7
  • Managed Agent can now be embedded opt-in in a Java host's JVM and Spring context, with dedicated connection pooling or a supplied DataSource. (#15718) by @yiliang114
  • /verify-pr now supports a failures ledger and rejects findings or blocked verdicts unless failures are attributed to the PR. (#15764) by @wenshao
  • Adds the qwen-managed-agent-admin launcher for running managed-agent offline maintenance commands by name, with help and unknown-command handling. (#15772) by @wenshao
  • feat(generated-ui): check a view's initial calculation before display (#15790) by @qqqys
Bug Fixes
  • Recovers valid XML tool calls when parameters quote other call markup, isolates malformed blocks, and prevents quoted examples from being dispatched. (#13579) by @yiliang114
  • Carries rewind identity through ACP/daemon clients so retries, cancellations, checkpoint resolution, recording, and notifications stay consistent. (#15441) by @yiliang114
  • Fixes release publishing checkout failures by using the run-scoped GitHub token for read-only checkout while keeping the bot PAT for write steps. (#15728) by @qwen-code-dev-bot
  • Pins pull request CI retries to the head SHA from the triggering event so reruns test the intended commit. (#15734) by @yiliang114
  • fix(cli): forward workflow switches into the CLI sandbox (#15740) (#15743) by @qwen-code-dev-bot
  • Recognizes invite-only qwen-latest-series- model aliases as 1M-context models in the context-window detector. (#15758) by @wenshao
  • Makes daemon-managed channels honor approvalMode even when no webhooks are configured, matching standalone startup. (#15754) by @qqqys
  • Shows the exception class in managed-agent scan summaries for non-first row failures that have no message. (#15725) by @yiliang114
  • Workspace Skill inventory queries now return a retained snapshot immediately and refresh in the background, while cold reads, deletion, and enablement wait for fresh data. (#14890) by @callmeYe
  • qwen4 model identifiers are now sized with a 1,000,000-token context window by default when no upstream catalog entry defines them. (#15762) by @wenshao
  • Acceptance tests now wait for the focused shell Tab byte to reach the child process before asserting exact input bytes, preventing flaky failures. (#15763) by @yiliang114
  • Managed runtime distribution now publishes verified server artifacts to GitHub Releases and OSS without requiring Maven Central, keeping CLI downloads unchanged. (#15782) by @doudouOUC
  • Generated UI is now offered only to sessions whose client can render MCP Apps, while unsupported clients receive a clear unsupported-client reason. (#15720) by @qqqys
  • In Web Shell, live Generated UI cards now attach and show their interactive view immediately when tool results arrive instead of requiring reopen. (#15787) by @qqqys
  • Desktop release preparation now resets Git metadata on self-hosted runners before checkout to avoid stale-workspace failures. (#15761) by @yiliang114
Documentation
  • Documents managed-agent shared-Session queue behavior and advises giving slow-probed gated definitions their own Session. (#15724) by @yiliang114
Internal Changes

qwen-code.html:
Highlights

See the complete change list below.

Breaking Changes

  • fix(qqbot)!: restore per-group session isolation under thread scope (#13882) by @Eric-GoodBoy-Tech

Complete Change List

Features
  • Adds opt-in daemon token persistence: qwen daemon start --save-token stores the bearer token in an owner-only file, qwen daemon token manages it, and daemon stop removes it. (#15023) by @wenshao
  • Adds idle-only manual context compression for Workspace-bound Managed Sessions via public API and the WebShell context-usage popover, preserving audit history. (#15104) by @doudouOUC
  • Aligns OpenTUI input, editing, drafts, and /statusline behavior with Ink, adding configurable status lines and more predictable completion, queue, and cancel handling. (#14964) by @chiga0
  • feat(shell): remind the model to record files a command writes (#15055) by @zjgzx1988
  • Managed Workspace recovery now waits for durable settlement before continuing, shows recovery reasons and valid actions in WebShell, and gates message sending. (#15131) by @doudouOUC
  • Embedding hosts can now show unavailable models as disabled rows in the composer picker, with hover or focus hints and optional host-provided actions. (#15015) by @callmeYe
  • feat(managed-agent): Add session lifecycle UI and reading exports (#15100) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(generated-ui): expose interaction outcomes and applied parameter snapshots (#15004) by @qqqys
  • feat(managed-agent): expose durable capacity observations (#15162) by @yiliang114
  • Pages Managed checkpoint history, adds durable model API error codes, and shows running indicators in Managed sidebar rows for clearer session feedback. (#15170) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(core): gate scheduled tasks on a shell command run outside the model (#15069) by @wenshao
  • Session lists now support case-insensitive title filtering before pagination, with archive filtering and a WebShell title search box. (#15157) by @yiliang114
  • feat(managed-agent): read the Harness credentials from one file (#15063) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): manage MCP servers without recreating sessions (#15119) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(cli): align OpenTUI Vim, history and live output with Ink (#15067) by @chiga0
  • feat(managed-agent): Enable public subagent delegation by default (#15171) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(managed-agent): Start daemon and Managed locally with one command (#14928) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(cli): ship private Bun and preserve interpreter boundaries (#14959) by @chiga0
  • feat(mods): skip hooks for Claude Code events this runtime does not run (#15273) by @qqqys
  • feat(mods): send a Mod's own tool.check ask to the user (#15306) by @qqqys
  • feat(serve): carry a scheduled-task gate through the daemon and Web Shell (#15211) by @wenshao
  • feat(ci): switchable Linux runner fleet (hosted/arm64) via LINUX_RUNNER_FLEET variable + dispatch option (#15329) by @yiliang114
  • feat(serve): bind reviewed PR when a /review prompt is admitted (#15207) by @wenshao
  • feat(cli): add a capability parity matrix against the Managed Agent path (#15085) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): Enable unified Shell session lifecycle (#15330) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(managed): gate managed automations on a Runtime probe run before the claim (#15218) by @wenshao
  • feat(web-shell): let users reorder sidebar workspaces (#15360) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): Add web_fetch to Workspace Sessions (#15313) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(cli): add the PR watch probes behind the scheduled-task gate (#15057) by @qqqys
  • feat(managed-agent): Add a shared Harness pool for Kubernetes (#15255) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(verify-pr): configure the assets host and branch once (#15377) by @wenshao
  • feat(web-shell): expose model output language in settings panel (#15363) by @wenshao
  • feat(serve): give managed workspace sessions todo_write (#15076) (#15089) by @wenshao
  • feat(serve): persist max-sessions in settings.json (#15419) by @wenshao
  • feat(web-shell): add unified recent sessions sidebar (#14904) by @deggs7
  • feat(mods): read session facts and the clock (#15348) by @qqqys
  • feat(verify-pr): add a watch mode backed by the PR probe gate (#15409) by @wenshao
  • feat(memory): add scoped external import jobs for CLI and HTTP (#14281) by @callmeYe
  • feat(ci): fail fast when a pool host drifts off the font baseline (#15410) by @yiliang114
  • feat(cli): attach a terminal to daemon sessions (#15209) by @wenshao
  • feat(cli): add the /autofix-pr reaction layer: guarded push, sync, replies, re-runs and the skill (#15385) by @wenshao
Bug Fixes
  • Release tarball checks now verify execute bits for every spawned vendored binary, including the Landlock runner, preventing silent permission regressions. (#15008) by @yiliang114
  • Fixes an issue where directory changes could make a completed session appear interrupted, while keeping real pending prompts and tool calls recoverable. (#15012) by @ytahdn
  • Fixes CI by enrolling OpenTUI parity integration tests in the no-AK lane so required test selection passes. (#15142) by @yiliang114
  • Fixes a core TypeScript build failure by removing a duplicate import in a chat test, with no product behavior change. (#15146) by @ytahdn
  • Gives fast Java CI jobs priority for SDK Java host-lock tickets while preventing starvation of full-tier jobs. (#15035) by @qwen-code-dev-bot
  • Workflow agent subagent IDs now include the Workflow tool call ID when available, helping Web Shell link subagents to the call that started them. (#15145) by @qqqys
  • Official DeepSeek support now uses deepseek-flash, accepts images for that exact model, and aligns effort mapping with DeepSeek's API. (#15164

qwen-code.html:
Highlights

See the complete change list below.

Breaking Changes

No known breaking changes.

Complete Change List

Features
  • feat(daemon): support session-targeted Skill and Extension refresh (#14050) by @callmeYe
  • feat(runtime-broker): Session-create warm for Workspace-isolated bound Sessions (#14599) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(managed-agent): ship a configuration template in the reference distribution (#14631) by @wenshao
  • feat(serve): run private CSI file turns through Hosted Harness (#14487) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(managed-agent): support local and SSH workspace file references (#14639) by @doudouOUC
  • Adds a read-only --check preflight that prints PASS, WARN, FAIL, or SKIP for managed-agent deployment checks and exits nonzero on failure. (#14632) by @wenshao
  • Lets a successor Hosted owner finish private CSI file turns that already have durable receipts, preserving tool responses and avoiding repeated file operations. (#14523) by @doudouOUC
  • Managed Agent submissions now accept up to 8 MiB of attachment input, preserve large pending requests across refresh, and let users discard unrecoverable drafts. (#14628) by @doudouOUC
  • Hosted Turn recovery now asks the Runtime Broker for execution evidence and treats unprovable outcomes as unknown instead of transient faults. (#14669) by @wenshao
  • Adds systemd units and setup guidance for single-host managed-agent deployments so Runtime workers stay running when Broker restarts (#14633) by @wenshao
  • Parks managed-agent turns with unknown Runtime outcomes for later rechecks instead of repeatedly retrying cancellation, keeping them active and avoiding false FAILED results (#14681) by @wenshao
  • feat(artifacts): record files the agent creates or edits (#14292) by @zjgzx1988
  • Adds a managed-agent credential bootstrap that generates required deployment tokens and writes protected configuration to simplify secure setup. (#14634) by @wenshao
  • Completes private CSI cold recovery so settled file work can resume from saved results without repeating file effects or extra model requests. (#14695) by @doudouOUC
  • Adds an optional Generated UI extension that renders model-generated HTML/CSS cards with bounded local JavaScript, letting users adjust inputs without another model turn. (#14338) by @qqqys
  • feat(workflow): authorize daemon ancestor workflows (#14646) by @qqqys
  • feat(web-shell): show per-model TTFT and output speed in Token Usage (#14728) by @qqqys
  • feat(runtime): add original CSI application retirement (#14698) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(telemetry): Record reasoning effort on LLM spans (#14718) by @zonemeen
  • feat(serve): add local daemon discovery and control commands (#14739) by @wenshao
  • feat(web-shell): Polish advanced table controls and copying (#14707) by @ytahdn
  • feat(core): account tool result sizes from producer to injection (#14545) by @yiliang114
  • feat(web-shell): add trajectory follow and pause controls (PR7B) (#14723) by @qqqys
  • feat(web-shell): delete selected message groups from session history (#14297) by @ytahdn
  • feat(core): honor preview budgets and make truncated previews recoverable (#14546) by @yiliang114
  • feat(web-shell): Preview collapsed Home content on hover (#14826) by @ytahdn
  • feat(web-shell): preview PDFs with the native browser viewer (#14825) by @ytahdn
  • feat(web-shell): improve token usage hierarchy (#14648) by @ytahdn
  • feat(mods): support tool middleware in interactive terminals (#14565) by @qqqys
  • feat(web-shell): show background shell task runtime details (#14831) by @ytahdn
  • feat(core): report why loop protection stopped a turn (#14858) by @qqqys
  • feat(serve): add qwen daemon start (#14869) by @wenshao
  • feat(channels): add WeCom application callback support (#13976) by @callmeYe
  • feat(serve): add daemon status detail (#14902) by @wenshao
  • feat(cli): expose experimental Mods in settings (#14889) by @qqqys
  • feat(web-shell): preview DOCX files across file entry points (#14868) by @ytahdn
  • feat(web-shell): refresh model catalogs from the model selector (#14685) by @callmeYe
  • feat(serve): add daemon start --wait (#14914) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): expose session MCP catalog in WebShell (#14916) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(runtime): add explicit idle resident Workspace retirement (#14765) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(web-shell): consolidate trajectory chrome into a summary bar and toolbar (#14913) by @qqqys
  • feat(managed-agent): Support approval changes during a turn (#14920) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(managed-agent): simplify existing local project onboarding (#14970) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(generated-ui): bundle Generated UI behind an experimental flag (#14888) by @qqqys
  • feat(web-shell): show model refresh as an icon beside search (#14983) by @callmeYe
  • feat(managed-agent): import enabled skills at session creation (#14930) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(serve): add daemon restart (#14929) by @wenshao
  • feat(cua): streamline computer use and port native reliability fixes (#14846) by @LaZzyMan
  • feat(web-shell): support managed session rename (#14987) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(serve): add persisted workspace artifact library (#14867) by @BZ-D
  • feat(workflow): add per-turn human-origin workflow hints (#14876) by @qqqys
  • feat(web-shell): open trajectory record details as a drill-in or side panel (#14984) by @qqqys
  • feat(core): add a real PTY backend for the Bun runtime (#14046

qwen-code.html:
Highlights

See the complete change list below.

Breaking Changes

No known breaking changes.

Complete Change List

Features
  • Adds optional model-generated layouts to Test Failure Explorer, with validation and fallback to the fixed view (#14269) by @qqqys
  • The Web Shell mobile composer no longer shows the ↑ and ↓ history buttons, reducing clutter while keeping history search available. (#14220) by @pomelo-nwu
  • The Web Shell trajectory panel now includes a collapsible Recent executions section that shows live requests and tools with elapsed time and final durations. (#14071) by @qqqys
  • Managed sessions created from published AgentDefinitions can now load static Skills and pass pinned MCP server and Hook catalog selections to Hosted Runtimes. (#14319) by @doudouOUC
  • Files now offers New file and New folder actions, and folder Delete asks for a second confirmation before permanently removing the folder and its contents. (#14169) by @ytahdn
  • Eligible legacy cancellations now require confirmation through the daemon or WebShell Continue flow before continuing, while explicitly user-cancelled work stays blocked. (#14087) by @yiliang114
  • Hosted parent agents can launch snapshot-isolated child agents that read a frozen workspace copy without changing files, running commands, or affecting the parent. (#14265) by @wenshao
  • Clicking the workspace folder beside the chat title now opens and selects the Files tree in the right panel, with keyboard and focus preserved. (#14344) by @ytahdn
  • Managed sessions now integrate into the home and sidebar, supporting workspace creation, approval policy and model selection, and context usage in the composer. (#14316) by @doudouOUC
  • The Files panel adds a Delete menu for regular files, requiring a permanent-deletion confirmation for the selected trusted local workspace. (#14158) by @ytahdn
  • Adds resident Kubernetes Workspace file sessions that retain an original Pod and fixed CSI PVC so configured Workspaces preserve files across sessions. (#14340) by @doudouOUC
  • Adds Shell Full Access and default/auto-edit/yolo switching for built-in Workspace-bound qwen-code Sessions without losing history, Workspace, or drafts. (#14323) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(mods): support commands in interactive terminals (PR4a) (#14268) by @qqqys
  • feat(providers): add QwenCloud as the first /auth entry (#14073) by @yiliang114
  • feat(ci): route the release lane's hosted stragglers onto ECS runners (#14336) by @yiliang114
  • feat(web-shell): add side task archive controls (#14300) by @yiliang114
  • feat(managed-agent): Add SSH Tool Runtime support (#14318) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(web-shell): list every Managed task kind in the task panel (#14415) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): H4f-c public task cancel for background Shell and Monitor tasks (#14412) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): link a child task to its child Session (#13746 F2) (#14413) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): Improve workspace selection and tool progress (#14405) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(managed-agent): project channel deliveries as tasks and serve their cancel (#13746 F3) (#14414) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): record Turn input and cancel as durable command operations (D7-1) (#14404) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): support native macOS workspace runtime (#14442) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(qqbot): accept inbound files and voice messages (#14343) by @Eric-GoodBoy-Tech
  • feat(managed-agent): reconcile acceptance-unknown operations through one rule (D7-2) (#14443) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): reconcile a parked SSH Workspace registration (D7-2) (#14456) by @wenshao
  • feat(runtime-broker): Workspace-resident Tool Runtime for bound Sessions (#14435) by @doudouOUC
  • fix(ci): run three hosted control-plane jobs on the ECS pool (#14469) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): add the opt-in java_durable admission profile (D7-3) (#14470) by @wenshao
  • feat(ci): gate Managed Agent changes on a full SDK Java run before merge (#14397) by @yiliang114
  • feat(serve): attach private CSI Sessions to Hosted text turns (#14081) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(managed-agent): reconcile parked Session title deliveries (D7-2) (#14475) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): register the Managed engine in paired daemons (#14483) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): allow approval changes in stored agent sessions (#14484) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(managed-agent): support Plan mode and inline attachments (#14531) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(workflow): discover trusted ancestor workflows in local sessions (#14369) by @qqqys
  • feat(managed-agent): Support per-run automation cancellation (#14526) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(managed-agent): bound half-open Hosted event streams behind a keepalive capability (#14135) (#14512) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): connect the composer to pinned Skills (#14602) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(web-shell): add approval mode allowlist (#14345) by @ytahdn
Bug Fixes
  • Fixes plan approval crashes during journal-only interrupted turns so takeover can settle the session instead of failing terminally (#14160) by @wenshao
  • Fixes checkstyle build failures in the Java SDK by reordering FG8 test imports (#14305) by @wenshao
  • Standardizes Managed Agent timestamps to Unix epoch milliseconds and updates query mappings for consistent data handling (#14185) by @doudouOUC
  • Fixes CSI preparation failures by retaining input, tool declaration, and intent resources through the HTTP store (#14180) by @doudouOUC
  • Managed Hosted model prompts now stay aligned with declared tools, including empty or changed tool sets, so tool guidance and examples remain accurate. (#14306) by @doudouOUC

qwen-code.html:
Highlights

See the complete change list below.

Breaking Changes

No known breaking changes.

Complete Change List

Features
  • feat(managed-agent): H4e-b2 the lead's mailbox over Session messages (#13892) by @wenshao
  • A new private extension imports Vitest 3.2 JSON reports and exposes failures, errors, counts, and diagnostics through MCP tools with search and pagination. (#13854) by @qqqys
  • Opt-in headless Mods now support TypeScript authoring, relative imports, typed non-secret configuration, and dependency validation before startup. (#13890) by @qqqys
  • Adds a default-off option allowing authorized public REST and WebShell sessions to use foreground Shell with mandatory approval. (#13674) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(managed-agent): Introduce the EventTransport seam behind the after-commit publisher (#13909) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): Stop Hosted team members with request_shutdown (H4e-b3a) (#13923) by @wenshao
  • Opt-in headless Mod runtime gains ordered middleware dispatch, command interception, and bounded failure recovery without resetting module state. (#13915) by @qqqys
  • Adds a Test Failure Explorer app that lets users browse, search, page through, and copy analysis requests for up to 20 selected test failures. (#13916) by @qqqys
  • Enables H3 Monitor and background Shell capabilities, allowing background runs to outlive their turn and output artifacts. (#13889) by @wenshao
  • Adds a Java mirror of the managed-event-envelope contract with derivation, validation, deduplication, and fixture tests, without changing runtime behavior. (#13940) by @wenshao
  • Adds a selection menu to completed Web Shell assistant replies with Copy plain text and Copy Markdown actions while preserving selected formatting. (#13833) by @ytahdn
  • Adds Web Shell task reminders for tool approval or AskUserQuestion answers, with notification controls, authorization prompts, and in-panel help. (#13832) by @ytahdn
  • Enables opt-in Mods in trusted headless main sessions to intercept tool calls, rewrite arguments, refuse calls, return synthetic results, and check permissions. (#13950) by @qqqys
  • feat(managed-agent): verify tool publications asynchronously (#13654) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(web-shell): add Managed child Agent task panel (#13936) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(managed-agent): recover Hosted G3 parked turns (#13777) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(runtime): add private CSI file worker with local-process isolation (#13899) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(managed-agent): member board tools ride the session_command channel end to end (H4e-b3b) (#13928) by @wenshao
  • feat(web-shell): add read-only Excel artifact previews (#13664) by @ytahdn
  • feat(managed-agent): H4 workflow child runtime (#13858) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): member-to-member messages ride the session_command channel (H4e-b3c) (#13955) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): give a Monitor auto-stop its remote exit evidence (#13896) (#13929) by @wenshao
  • feat(web-shell): Reuse standard UI for Managed Agents (#13973) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(managed-agent): add L4 Shell and MCP session lifecycle (#13931) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(core): add a convergence reminder for read-only exploration (#13601) by @yiliang114
  • feat(cli): add repeatable --disable-mcp-server to exclude servers per invocation (#14003) by @yiliang114
  • feat(web-shell): Add workspace file browser and previews (#13878) by @ytahdn
  • feat(managed-agent): add durable team plan approval (H4e-b3d) (#13974) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): Add the LiteTopic journal-event transport (MQ2b) (#14029) by @wenshao
  • feat(web-shell): bridge trajectory history and live lifecycle state (#13952) by @qqqys
  • feat(web-shell): pulse the header environment entry while tasks run (#14048) by @ytahdn
  • feat(web-shell,desktop): update Qwen Code logo to the current brand mark (#14052) by @pomelo-nwu
  • feat(managed-agent): Add the public-event transport and the wake/materialization consumers (MQ2c) (#14080) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): consolidate persistence into a 32-table baseline (#14069) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(web-shell): open context details in the side panel from the ring (#14086) by @pomelo-nwu
  • feat(runtime-broker): add bounded retention for terminal JDBC history (#13642) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(web-shell): review MCP App messages before submission (PR3a) (#13958) by @qqqys
  • feat(managed-agent): H4f public task cancel for workflow tasks (#14076) by @wenshao
  • feat(mods): support selected Claude tool input contracts (PR3b) (#14027) by @qqqys
  • feat(sdk-java): add private CSI Session and native SQL authority (#13996) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(managed-agent): publish an experimental reference distribution (#14176) by @yiliang114
  • feat(web-shell): show a reduced header on the new-task page (#14159) by @ytahdn
  • feat(web-shell): upload files by dropping into the file tree (#14145) by @ytahdn
  • feat(web-shell): open workflow agents in the detail panel (#14175) by @qqqys
Bug Fixes
  • Runtime Broker now rejects closed or deleted managed-agent sessions with a non-retryable error, and closed Hosted Harness connectors fail immediately. (#13330) by @wenshao
  • Child worktree runs now settle correctly after merges and stopped runs discard their worktrees, preventing stale workspace state. (#13872) by @wenshao
  • Monitor admission and initial-call startup failures are now classified tool errors with full guidance instead of false success. (#13460) by @GoldArowana
  • CLI now strips a leading UTF-8 BOM when reading MCP configuration files, including project .mcp.json and --mcp-config file input. (#13596) by @Bug-killer-prog

qwen-code.html:
Highlights

See the complete change list below.

Breaking Changes

No known breaking changes.

Complete Change List

Features
  • Restores the selected text-only connection and validated session or workspace route after Android Activity recreation, while preserving explicit retry screens after failures. (#12247) by @jabrailkhalil
  • Improves mobile profile screen accessibility with clearer connection actions, editor labels, validation announcements, and scrollable storage recovery. (#12129) by @jabrailkhalil
  • Adds an experimental Kubernetes CSI-backed runtime that validates workspaces, persists pod identity, and records durable worker acknowledgements for managed sessions. (#13289) by @doudouOUC
  • Adds background Shell and Monitor capabilities to the Managed Agent runtime, enabling durable background shell sessions and task event reporting. (#13265) by @wenshao
  • Web Shell /btw side can now create independent side-task conversations in a parent session's secondary workspace, including while the parent is responding. (#13468) by @wenshao
  • Agent and Goal coordination tools are now deferred by default and discovered on demand, reducing unnecessary tool declarations in ordinary tool-call sessions. (#13033) by @yiliang114
  • Local Managed Agent runtime tool outcomes are now durably recorded, including parameters, receipts, and checkpoints, before results are returned to the model. (#13291) by @wenshao
  • Hosted approval requests can now include bounded previews of file and shell input, exposed through public and WebShell APIs with truncation metadata. (#13400) by @yiliang114
  • Lets creators change a Workspace-bound Managed Session's working directory through a durable, idempotent operation. (#13247) by @wenshao
  • Adds read-only glob file discovery to Hosted Workspace /2 profiles while keeping searches inside the session working directory. (#13166) by @yiliang114
  • Adds planned Stage H5 agent channel API route shapes and persistence tables for channel routes and outbound deliveries. (#13497) by @wenshao
  • feat(web-shell): take back a cancelled prompt that produced nothing (#13488) by @wenshao
  • feat(hosted): show captured inputs in native approval cards (#13407) by @yiliang114
  • feat(managed-agent): EventTransport message-envelope contract (#13498) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): adopt the next Hosted Harness generation (G3) (#13174) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): enumerate the public and WebShell surface with an admission gate (#13543) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): H4a child agent and child acceptance record contract (#13505) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): give Hosted turns the Workspace's project context (#13168) by @yiliang114
  • feat(managed-agent): H6a schedule and automation run record contract (#13536) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): H5a channel route and delivery record contract (#13548) by @wenshao
  • feat(web-shell): Add fullscreen viewing for history tables (#13589) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): prove Shell process-group stops with a worker ledger (M5c) (#13352) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): add W1c offline workspace migration (#13260) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(agents): session-centric multi-agent collaboration (#13467) by @yiliang114
  • feat(managed-agent): add reliable ACTIVE Workspace deletion (L3) (#13354) by @doudouOUC
  • feat(hooks): apply PreToolUse updatedInput with full revalidation (#13442) by @qqqys
  • feat(web-shell): add trajectory search and diagnostic filters (#13264) by @qqqys
  • feat(web-shell): restore aggregated workspace hosts in sidebar (#13677) by @yiliang114
  • feat(managed-agent): persist workspace actor roles and session owners (#13544) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): H4b child Session runtime (#13550) by @wenshao
  • feat(web-shell): browse earlier trajectory windows (#13716) by @qqqys
  • feat(agents): remove the thread backend and run A2A on sessions (#13583) by @yiliang114
  • feat(trajectory): preserve model request execution identity (#13740) by @qqqys
  • feat(managed-agent): H5b/H5c channel runtime for the email reference adapter (#13572) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): add opt-in production replay-floor advancement for Session event retention (#12380) (#13621) by @qwen-code-dev-bot
  • feat(managed-agent): H4c workflow child kind and child launch budget (#13754) by @wenshao
  • feat(managed-agent): enforce workspace actor roles across the bound-Session surface (#13545) by @wenshao

gh-earendil-works-pi.html:
New Features
  • Image input for classifiers: codemode models.classify() accepts images for TypeSafe's Jev and Cloudflare's Clef models on typesafe, cloudflare-workers-ai, and OpenRouter. See Use classifier models and Codemode.
  • Models Configuration reference: every provider, model, model override, and compatibility field of models.json, generated from its schema. See Models Configuration.
  • Summaries without a fixed output cap: compaction and branch summaries use the model's output limit, so long reasoning no longer makes them fail. See Compaction.
  • Codemode waits for a free worker: parallel scripts and in-process subagents queue instead of failing, and PI_CODEMODE_MAX_WORKERS raises the limit. See Codemode limits.
  • Rex terminal support: OSC 8 hyperlinks, truecolor, and inline images.
Added
  • Added a Models Configuration reference generated from the models.json schema, listing all provider, model, model override, and compatibility fields (#10790)
  • Codemode models.classify() now accepts images for TypeSafe's Jev and Cloudflare's Clef models on typesafe, cloudflare-workers-ai, and OpenRouter, and lists Clef Omni and Jev 1.14 on Workers AI.
  • Provider-level compat in models.json now also applies to classifier models, with the System One fields imageInput and sendImageOptInHeader for proxies that serve another service's classifiers. Extension classifier models accept compat too.
  • Added MiniMax-M3.1-Flash to the minimax and minimax-cn providers, with thinking levels low through max (#11121)
  • Added support for the Rex terminal: OSC 8 hyperlinks, truecolor, and inline images (#11131, #11150 by @petrroll, #11183 by @nihaals)
Changed
  • Provider attribution headers now come from pi-ai's client identity. Extensions' before_provider_headers handlers no longer see the OpenRouter, NVIDIA NIM, and OpenCode attribution headers; returning null for one still removes it. Cloudflare requests send pi's detailed User-Agent instead of pi-coding-agent, as do GitHub release checks for tool downloads, and OpenCode requests send x-opencode-client whenever attribution is enabled, not only with a session.
  • generateSummary() and generateSummaryWithUsage() now ignore their reserveTokens parameter. Summary requests use the model's output limit instead.
  • Changed the default GitHub Copilot model from gpt-5.4, which Copilot retired, to gpt-6.1-sol.
  • Changed the default NVIDIA model to nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl-120b-a12b (#10910 by @cv)
  • Changed the default Xiaomi model to mimo-v2.6-pro for the xiaomi and Xiaomi Token Plan providers, since mimo-v2.5-pro left the catalog.
  • Grok 4.3 and Grok 4.5 on the xai provider now offer the xhigh thinking level.
  • Sign in with ChatGPT: ChatGPT Business workspace usage-limit errors are not retried and tell the user to ask their workspace admin to increase the limit.
Fixed
  • Fixed compaction and branch summaries failing with "generation hit the token cap" when reasoning used most of the fixed summary output limit. Summaries now use the model's output limit, and compaction.reserveTokens only controls when compaction starts (#9512, #9075).
  • Fixed models.schema.json missing descriptions for provider and model fields, so editors showed no hints for them (#10790)
  • Fixed pi update failing with "Managed install marker is missing or invalid" when managed-install.json starts with a UTF-8 BOM, which Windows PowerShell 5.1 adds when it rewrites the file.
  • Fixed HTML export showing literal asterisks for Markdown bold and italic next to CJK punctuation (#3353, #10154)
  • Fixed the terminal staying in mouse-tracking, focus-reporting, Kitty keyboard, and alternate-screen modes when pi exits without its normal terminal teardown, which flooded the shell prompt with escape sequences (#11170)
  • Fixed concurrent extension select/confirm/input/editor dialogs and inline custom() components in interactive mode: a second dialog replaced the first and the first promise never settled; closing the visible dialog now shows the previous one again (#11166, #9909)
  • Fixed pasting in the shell hanging after copying text in pi and suspending it with Ctrl+Z on Linux: the background wl-copy/xclip/xsel process that keeps serving the clipboard was suspended along with pi (#11179)
  • Fixed codemode scripts failing immediately when both codemode workers are busy, for example with parallel codemode calls or in-process subagents. Scripts now wait up to 60 seconds for a free worker, and PI_CODEMODE_MAX_WORKERS raises the limit of two workers (#11184)
  • Fixed extensions failing to load when importing @earendil-works/pi-ai/models (e.g. for clampThinkingLevel) by exposing the subpath through the extension loader aliases and virtual modules (#11156)
  • Fixed mcp.json files that start with a UTF-8 BOM failing to parse, which skipped all their MCP servers and made pi mcp add/pi mcp remove fail (#11191)
  • Fixed /compact <instructions> ignoring the instructions when summarizing the start of a turn that compaction splits. When the split turn was the only new content since the last compaction, the instructions were ignored entirely (#11058)
  • Fixed resumed sessions and /tree navigation leaving extension tools inactive when the branch recorded its tools before they were registered, such as tools from extensions installed after the session started. Extension tools the branch never added or removed are now active unless they are registered with defaultActive: false (#11062, #11075)
  • Fixed sessions breaking after recovery from a response cut off at the output limit: the truncated tool call was omitted but its tool results were kept, so providers rejected every later request (#11227, #11233 by @petrroll)
  • Fixed the grep

gh-earendil-works-pi.title: Pi v1.3.0
gh-earendil-works-pi.summary: New Features Choose where /share uploads: sessionShareDestination selects auto, gist, or radius. See Sessions and context and Export or share a session. Cache-preserving thinking level changes on OpenAI GPT-6: changing the thinking level mid-session with an…
gh-earendil-works-pi.html:
New Features
  • Choose where /share uploads: sessionShareDestination selects auto, gist, or radius. See Sessions and context and Export or share a session.
  • Cache-preserving thinking level changes on OpenAI GPT-6: changing the thinking level mid-session with an API key keeps the prompt cache.
  • Kimi Code over Chat Completions: tools added mid-conversation no longer invalidate the prompt cache. models.json base URL overrides must now include /v1. See Providers.
  • Clean model switching: thinking from a previous model is dropped instead of being shown to the new model as text.
  • Resumed sessions keep their active tools: --tools +name/-name applies on top of them. See Tools.
Added
  • Changing the thinking level mid-session on OpenAI GPT-6 models (API key) now keeps the prompt cache (#10853)
  • Added the sessionShareDestination setting to choose automatic, GitHub gist, or Radius uploads for /share (#10870 by @vegarsti)
Changed
  • Changed the kimi-coding provider to use OpenAI Chat Completions at https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1, the protocol used by the official Kimi Code client. K3, K3-256K, and Kimi For Coding now accept tools added mid-conversation without invalidating the prompt cache. models.json overrides of the kimi-coding base URL must now include /v1 (#10720)
  • Changed model switching to drop thinking blocks from earlier assistant messages produced by a different model, instead of sending them as plain text. The new model previously saw the old model's reasoning as part of its replies and could start writing its own reasoning into the visible answer (#10995)
Fixed
  • Pinned internal Pi dependencies to exact release versions to prevent fresh installs from mixing incompatible packages (#10865)
  • Fixed resumed sessions dropping tools activated during the session. Resume now restores the session's active tools, with --tools +name/-name entries applied to them, unless --tools with tool names, --no-tools, or --no-builtin-tools selects tools explicitly (#10785)
  • Fixed stopping a codemode script or reaching its deadline waiting for a non-interruptible built-in to return on Bun (#10748)
  • Fixed repeated codemode timeouts or aborts accumulating surviving workers; admission now limits live workers to two across sessions, counting cancelled workers until actual exit (#10748)
  • Fixed --model choosing a provider by catalog order when several providers offer the match; Pi now prefers the provider with credentials and otherwise reports the ambiguity. --models and enabledModels add a model for each provider that offers it and warn about the ambiguity (#10160)
  • Fixed read line-range labels for numeric-string or null arguments in the TUI, session tree, HTML exports, and examples (#9887)
  • Fixed the Nix flake build failing when a provider switched APIs: the model catalog pin is now refreshed from the newest published catalog when its model API groups differ, and releases pin the newest catalog and build with it before tagging (#10985)
  • Fixed the Nix package putting its Node.js first on PATH, which made bash tool shells use Pi's Node instead of the user's node/npm. Pi's Node is now only a fallback (#10519)
  • Fixed prompt templates dropping empty quoted arguments ("" or ''), which shifted later positional arguments and prevented positional defaults from applying (#10867)
  • Fixed the Nix package build failing in its install check because it still expected chord and esbuild, which Pi no longer depends on
  • Fixed tool-call argument parsing dropping fields when a string contains an invalid \u escape such as \usepackage (#10868)
  • Fixed Anthropic and Bedrock Claude requests failing with a 400 when an error tool result contains images; the images are now sent after the tool results of the turn, so the model still sees them (#10794)
  • Fixed OpenCode Go Gemini models failing with a 404 by moving OpenCode Zen and OpenCode Go to the opencode.ai/inference endpoints, and added Google Generative AI support to the OpenCode Go provider
  • Fixed OpenCode Go MiniMax M2.7 failing with "Model does not support this protocol" by using the Anthropic Messages API
  • Fixed automatic retry not triggering for gateway Unable to forward upstream stream errors (#10920)
  • Fixed automatic retry not triggering for The service is temporarily unavailable errors, which also made compaction fail on the first attempt (#10965)
  • Fixed OpenAI-compatible responses showing thinking after the answer when a proxy such as LiteLLM sends reasoning and content in the same stream chunk (#10926)
  • Fixed Gemini 4 Argon requests on Google Vertex failing with "Thinking budget is not supported", and its thinking level being ignored on the Gemini API (#10890)
  • Fixed Xiaomi MiMo models failing with a 400 at the minimal thinking level; they now expose only the off and high levels (#10818)
  • Fixed openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol using a 272K context window instead of the 500K window Codex now provides (#10840)
  • Fixed tool calls whose final arguments are malformed JSON silently running with only the fields parsed before the error; they now fail validation and show the model the raw arguments it sent (#10897)
  • Fixed Claude Haiku 5.5 and Claude Opus 5 not supporting the off thinking level (#10753)
  • Fixed done() of an extension's ctx.ui.custom({ overlay: true }) closing the topmost overlay instead of its own, which left the finished overlay on screen and another extension's dialog unresolved (#10648, #10999 by @masonc15)

gh-earendil-works-pi.title: Pi v1.2.0
gh-earendil-works-pi.summary: New Features Per-key OpenRouter model lists: with an OpenRouter key, Pi lists only the models that key may use, with the key's context size, max output, and prices, including regional endpoints set in models.json. See OpenRouter. Published configuration…
gh-earendil-works-pi.html:
New Features
  • Per-key OpenRouter model lists: with an OpenRouter key, Pi lists only the models that key may use, with the key's context size, max output, and prices, including regional endpoints set in models.json. See OpenRouter.
  • Published configuration schemas: add $schema to settings.json, models.json, keybindings, and themes for editor validation and completion. See Settings, Models, Keybindings, and Themes.
  • Clipboard copies over remote sessions: PI_CLIPBOARD_OSC52=1 sends copied text to a remote client's clipboard when Pi cannot detect the remote session, such as a multiplexer attached from another machine. See Pi Process Configuration.
  • Codemode improvements: tool declarations show input constraints such as integer, minimum/maximum, and default, and codemode rows show elapsed and total time. See Codemode.
  • before_agent_start for extension-triggered runs: runs started by pi.sendMessage(..., { triggerTurn: true }) go through the same setup as prompts. See Events and concurrency.
Breaking Changes
  • Published generated configuration schemas for models, settings, keybindings, and themes at https://pi.dev/schemas/*.schema.json. The theme schema moved to https://pi.dev/schemas/theme.schema.json; themes loaded during startup now receive the same schema validation as later reloads. Update theme $schema references, define reusable colors under vars, and remove unsupported metadata (#9880, #10751 by @christianklotz)
  • Changed before_agent_start to also fire for runs started by pi.sendMessage(..., { triggerTurn: true }) while idle. BeforeAgentStartEvent is now a union on messageType: "user" events carry prompt and images, and "custom" events carry the starting message and no prompt. Messages returned by handlers are added to both kinds of run, and pending deliverAs: "nextTurn" messages are delivered with the custom-message run. Handlers that should act only on user prompts must check event.messageType === "user" (#10267, #5581, #10739 by @davidbrai)
  • Changed the session to count as busy while a run starts, including during before_agent_start handlers: ctx.isIdle() is false, pi.sendMessage() queues into the starting run instead of starting a second run that failed with "Agent is already processing", pi.sendUserMessage() requires deliverAs, and an abort requested meanwhile aborts the run once it starts (#10739 by @davidbrai)
  • Changed pi mcp list --json to report resources: true for servers that offer resources instead of resources and resourceTemplates counts; Pi no longer lists resources when connecting (#10526)
Added
  • Added reachesTools to tool definitions, so tools that reach other tools (such as codemode and tool_search) declare which tools a call may reach; the MCP extension uses it to wait for the servers a call needs and to decide whether a replacement codemode or tool_search tool can reach MCP tools
  • Added aliases to tool namespaces; codemode's describeNamespace() and the namespace option of searchTools() match them, and MCP namespaces use the server name
  • Added per-key OpenRouter model lists: with an OpenRouter key, Pi lists only the chat models that key may use, with the key's context size, max output, and prices, including guardrails and regional endpoints set as the base URL in models.json. The list is saved and used offline (#10353, #10672 by @davidbrai)
  • Added PI_CLIPBOARD_OSC52=1 to send copied text to the terminal with OSC 52 after the local clipboard write, so copies reach a remote client's clipboard when Pi cannot detect the remote session, such as multiplexer attaches from another machine or remote IDE daemons (#10826, #10835, #10114)
  • Added elapsed time while a codemode script runs and its total time once finished to the codemode tool row, like bash rows (#10708)
Changed
  • Changed the showHardwareCursor setting to use only the terminal cursor instead of also drawing Pi's reverse-video cursor
  • Changed codemode tool declarations to show input constraints such as integer, minimum/maximum, length, pattern, and default as @ tags on property comments, so scripts see them without the tool repeating them in descriptions (#10707)
  • Changed codemode declarations of MCP tools to spell out the result type (content, structuredContent, isError) instead of referring to CallToolResult<T>, which describeTool(), searchTools(), and ALL_TOOLS showed without defining it; the codemode description no longer includes the shared MCP types
  • Changed serializeConversation() (compaction, branch summaries, bug reports) to omit thinking blocks; replayed thinking is often not in the live context, so including it could make a summarization request larger than the context it summarizes and fail
Fixed
  • Fixed codemode ignoring a // @options: line that is not the first line of the script, which ran the script without the requested timeout_ms; the call now fails with an error before the script runs (#10631)
  • Fixed Mistral streams being aborted mid-generation (e.g. during long thinking) after the request timeout; the timeout now applies only to waiting for response headers (#10609)
  • Fixed a symlinked AGENTS.md in a git worktree nested inside its main repo causing no project context file to load (#10681)
  • Fixed the code mode tool description claiming every failed tool call rejects; a tool that declares an output schema resolves with its value on failure too (e.g. bash with a nonzero exit)
  • Fixed runs started by pi.sendMessage(..., { triggerTurn: true }) removing system prompt sections added in before_agent_start after their first tool call, which changed the prompt mid-run and broke the provider prompt cache twice per run (#10267

gh-earendil-works-pi.html:
New Features
  • Program status reporting: terminals and agent dashboards that support OSC 7501 see whether Pi is working, blocked on a dialog or login, done, or failed. See Program status.
  • Claude Haiku 5.5: anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5, with adaptive thinking up to xhigh/max effort.
  • Adjust default tools with +name/-name: --tools entries like pi -t +codemode,-write change the default selection instead of replacing it. See Tools.
  • GPT-6 Luna and image classification: OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna is available as a classifier model through the Decisions API, and codemode's models.classify() accepts images for classifiers that support them. See Use classifier models.
  • Native llama.cpp decision models: Julia-1, Laya, Kev, lev, and OpenJev served by llama.cpp 0.6.0 or later run natively as classifiers through /v1/systemone. See Classification.
Added
  • Added +name and -name entries to --tools, which change the default tool selection instead of replacing it, for example pi -t +codemode
  • Added durationMs to the tool render context and to tool_execution_end extension events: the recorded execution time of a final tool result (#10549)
  • Added outputPad to the tool render context (#10557 by @rwachtler)
  • Added OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna as a classifier model through the Decisions API, available with OPENAI_API_KEY (see Use classifier models)
  • Added images to codemode's models.classify() context, so classifiers that accept images, such as GPT-6 Luna, can judge them
  • Added program status reporting with OSC 7501: terminals and agent dashboards that support it see whether Pi is working, blocked on a dialog or login, done, or failed. PI_PROGRAM_STATUS=1|0 overrides detection (see Terminal setup) (#10607)
  • Added aborted to agent_settled session, extension, and JSON events, so integrations can tell a cancelled run from a finished one (#10607)
  • Added Claude Haiku 5.5 (anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5), with adaptive thinking up to xhigh/max effort and prompt caching on Bedrock
  • Added native llama.cpp decision models: Julia-1, Laya, Kev, lev, and OpenJev served by llama.cpp 0.6.0 or later are listed only as classifiers through /v1/systemone instead of as chat models (see Classification) (#10382)
Changed
  • Changed outputPad to also apply to ! command output, tool output, and summary blocks (#9946, #10557 by @rwachtler)
  • Changed pi mcp login --timeout to limit the whole sign-in, including requests to the authorization server, instead of only the wait for the browser (#10565)
Fixed
  • Fixed bash and PowerShell results losing Took after reloading a session, and the live Took including wall-clock steps; both now show the recorded execution time (#10549)
  • Fixed managed installs keeping every old release; pi update now keeps only the new release and the one it updated from (#10392, #10511 by @davidbrai)
  • Fixed standalone binaries loading .env, .env.local, and .env.development from the launch directory into Pi's environment (#10473)
  • Fixed !! command headers losing their dim color once output arrives (#10557 by @rwachtler)
  • Fixed the codemode description not marking searchTools(), describeTool(), and describeNamespace() as async, which led models to serialize the unawaited promise as {} (#10555)
  • Fixed codemode output items running together, so models could not tell where one text() or console.log() output ended and the next began. With several text items, each now starts with a ==> text N/M <== line, and console calls follow the other output in one <console_output> block with one line per call
  • Fixed /mcp waiting for all servers to connect before opening; the manager now updates live and remains usable while enabling, reconnecting, or disabling servers (#10562)
  • Fixed images being dropped as "could not be resized" when running under node --watch on Node 24.19+ and 26.x, where Node posts its own messages on the image resize worker channel (#10527)
  • Fixed clipboard paste doing nothing in Termux, and failed copies there omitting the Termux:API install hint (#10391)
  • Fixed ! and RPC bash output keeping fragments of color codes, such as a stray m, when a code was split across output chunks (#10504)
  • Fixed MCP OAuth sign-ins that could not be cancelled while waiting on the authorization server and kept running after the session ended. The sign-in screen now cancels with Esc at every step, session shutdown aborts a running sign-in, and each request to the authorization server times out after 15 seconds (#10565)
  • Fixed shutdown waiting up to 15 seconds to refresh an MCP OAuth token that was about to expire, only to close the server's session (#10565)
  • Fixed the fullscreen text selection surviving session switches and other transcript rebuilds, which highlighted unrelated text in the new transcript (#9311, #10567 by @christianklotz)
  • Fixed OpenAI models on Bedrock ignoring the thinking level and always running at Bedrock's default reasoning effort (#9331, #10142 by @jsanter27)
  • Fixed model headers in models.json not overriding the originator and User-Agent headers of Codex requests (#10429 by @lucasmeijer)
  • Fixed server_busy and servers are currently busy

gh-earendil-works-pi.summary: New Features Tool patterns and --no-mcp: --tools and --exclude-tools accept * patterns, for example --tools read,codemode,'mcp__radius__*' keeps only one MCP server's tools. --tools now keeps MCP tools unless an entry starts with mcp__, and --no-mcp turns off…
gh-earendil-works-pi.html:
New Features
  • Tool patterns and --no-mcp: --tools and --exclude-tools accept * patterns, for example --tools read,codemode,'mcp__radius__*' keeps only one MCP server's tools. --tools now keeps MCP tools unless an entry starts with mcp__, and --no-mcp turns off MCP for one run. See Tools and MCP tools.
  • Codemode persists images: tools.read() on an image file now gives back an image block that image() can show. See Call tools.
Added
  • Added * patterns to --tools and --exclude-tools, for example --tools read,codemode,'mcp__radius__*'
  • Added --no-mcp to disable the built-in MCP support for one run
Fixed
  • Fixed syntax highlighting losing colors after the first line of multiline strings and comments in fenced code blocks (#10143)
  • Fixed codemode scripts not receiving images from read: tools.read() now resolves to an image block for image files, which image() shows (#10251)
  • Fixed MCP OAuth sign-in failing with invalid_redirect_uri on servers with OpenID Connect client registration, such as mcp.modem.dev: pi now registers as a native client (#10493)
  • Fixed --tools removing MCP tools, which left pi --tools codemode without any MCP servers. --tools now keeps MCP tools unless an entry starts with mcp__
  • Fixed MCP session shutdown returning while a server was still connecting, leaving its transport open until the server answered or timed out (#10249)
  • Fixed system prompt rules and the skills hint naming tools hidden by prepareLoadout. Hidden tools are left out of the rules, the skills hint names no tool when the file reader is hidden, and codemode shows each tool's prompt guidelines with its declaration; ToolLoadout gains getPromptGuidelines() (#10343)
  • Fixed Bedrock requests that fail with The pending stream has been canceled after a stalled HTTP/2 connection not being retried automatically (#10379)
  • Fixed codemode scripts that patch built-ins (for example Array.prototype.toJSON = ...) crashing pi and leaving the tool call unsettled. Built-ins are now frozen before the script runs, so such patches have no effect (#10444)

gh-earendil-works-pi.title: Pi v1.0.3
gh-earendil-works-pi.summary: New Features Azure Foundry Chat Completions — The azure provider (renamed from azure-openai-responses) now also serves Foundry Chat Completions deployments, starting with azure/deepseek-v4-pro. See Azure OpenAI. Codemode images saved to files — image() also…
gh-earendil-works-pi.html:
New Features
  • Azure Foundry Chat Completions — The azure provider (renamed from azure-openai-responses) now also serves Foundry Chat Completions deployments, starting with azure/deepseek-v4-pro. See Azure OpenAI.
  • Codemode images saved to files — image() also writes each image to a temp file and names the path in the result, so later turns can copy or move generated images. See Generate images.
Breaking Changes
  • Renamed the Azure provider from azure-openai-responses to azure. Rename the provider key in auth.json (or run /login again), in models.json, and in settings.json (defaultProvider, enabledModels patterns, and modelThinkingLevels keys). Sessions that used the old provider fall back to another model when resumed, and their prompt cache is not reused. The AZURE_OPENAI_* environment variables are unchanged (#9714 by @jsanter27)
Added
  • Added Azure Foundry Chat Completions deployments, starting with azure/deepseek-v4-pro (#9645, #9714 by @jsanter27)
Changed
  • Codemode image() now also saves each image to a temp file and names the path in the result, so later turns can copy or move generated images (#10310)
  • Output files (full text of truncated tool output, binary MCP resources, codemode images) are now readable only by the user
  • Home/End now always move the editor cursor to the line start/end; fullscreen transcript top/bottom moved to Ctrl+Home/Ctrl+End, which no longer move the editor cursor (#10314)
Fixed
  • Fixed subscription logins such as Sign in with ChatGPT failing with refresh_token_invalidated after a request was cancelled during an OAuth token refresh
  • Fixed codemode failing for the rest of a session after a pnpm global update removed the running install, and added a restart hint when errors occur after pi was updated or removed on disk (#10439)
  • Fixed interactive sessions reporting a read EIO or setRawMode EIO crash (and asking to run /bug) when the terminal went away, e.g. after closing the window or resuming a suspended pi in a closed terminal

gh-earendil-works-pi.html:
New Features
  • Nix flake — nix run github:earendil-works/pi/stable runs the latest release, and nix profile add github:earendil-works/pi/stable installs it. See Install pi.
  • Project overrides for MCP servers — .pi/mcp.json and /mcp can enable, disable, or change the exposure of a user-level server for one project. See Configure servers.
  • MCP Client ID Metadata Documents — oauth.clientRegistration: "cimd" lets authorization servers allow pi by its document URL instead of dynamic registration. See Authenticate with OAuth.
  • Tool renderers for any tool — pi.registerToolRenderer() draws calls to tools that are not registered yet, such as MCP tools in resumed sessions. See Tool rendering.
  • Cloudflare Clef classifiers — @cf/cloudflare/clef and @cf/cloudflare/clef-flash are usable from codemode scripts and extensions. See Use classifier models.
Added
  • Added a copy key (app.message.copy, default ctrl+x) to OAuth sign-in screens in /login, /mcp, and /mcp login, which copies the sign-in URL when the browser cannot be opened or the wrapped link cannot be selected.
  • Added oauth.clientRegistration: "cimd" for MCP servers, which identifies pi with its Client ID Metadata Document on pi.dev instead of dynamic client registration, so authorization servers can allow pi by URL (#10302)
  • Added project overrides for user-level MCP servers: a .pi/mcp.json entry without command or url sets only enabled, exposure, and toolExposure of the user-level server, and /mcp can enable or disable a server for the current project (#10277)
  • Added Cloudflare's Clef and Clef Flash classifier models to cloudflare-workers-ai, usable from codemode scripts and extensions (#10316 by @ndisidore, #10322 by @RealAlexandreAI)
  • Added pi.registerToolRenderer(), which chooses how calls to a tool are drawn, including tools that are not registered (#10285)
  • Added a Nix flake for macOS and Linux: nix run github:earendil-works/pi/stable runs the latest release, and nix profile add github:earendil-works/pi/stable installs it. See Install pi (#9137)
Changed
  • pi update on global npm installations now recommends migrating to the managed installation from the pi.dev installer, which pins all dependencies.
  • Anthropic tools added or redefined mid-conversation are now defined inline in the conversation, so redefining a tool under the same name keeps the prompt cache instead of resending the full tool list.
Fixed
  • Fixed installations resolving vulnerable brace-expansion 5.0.9 by pinning brace-expansion 5.0.12 as a direct dependency (GHSA-q2hr-2g5m-vwhr, GHSA-qhr7-859c-m2p7, GHSA-6j4f-fj2g-mc7p) (#10288)
  • Fixed a trailing comma in --models adding an extra model to the model cycle (#10334)
  • Fixed a codemode script that prints in a loop crashing pi by running out of memory: a script fails once its output passes 16 Mi characters or 100000 items (#10283)
  • Fixed JPEG, GIF, and WebP images rendered by extensions through Image not appearing in Kitty, Ghostty, WezTerm, and Warp (#10292)
  • Fixed MCP tool calls in resumed sessions and HTML exports rendering fully expanded until their server connected, or for good if it never did (#10285)
  • Fixed fullscreen Kitty images collapsing to a one-row strip after scrolling in WezTerm (#10319)
  • Fixed "Selected model is at capacity" provider errors ending the turn instead of being retried (#10278)
  • Fixed Cloudflare AI Gateway Claude models failing with a 404 by using dashed model IDs (claude-opus-5-5 instead of claude-opus-5.5)
  • Fixed Sign in with ChatGPT continuing when its callback port is taken by another login, which made the browser show "OAuth state mismatch"; it now fails with a port-in-use error (#10265)
  • Fixed Amazon Bedrock OpenAI models costing requests above 272k input tokens at the short-context rate; Bedrock models now include the pricing tiers listed on models.dev (#10326)
  • Fixed Amazon Bedrock Claude requests failing with "Invalid signature in thinking block" after the system prompt or tools changed (#10324)
  • Fixed Together DeepSeek V4 Pro losing its thinking level controls after Together renamed it to deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 (#10336 by @cv)
  • Fixed the default NVIDIA model pointing at nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b, which NVIDIA no longer serves; the default is now nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b
Removed
  • Removed npm-shrinkwrap.json from the published package. npm installations no longer pin transitive dependencies, and library consumers can now override them. Use the pi.dev installer for pinned installations (#5653)

gh-earendil-works-pi.title: Pi v1.0.0
gh-earendil-works-pi.summary: New Features Fullscreen by default — The TUI now runs fullscreen. Set tuiMode to "regular" to keep the terminal's normal scrollback. See Terminal and display. Leaner codemode — About 40% fewer prompt tokens, and errors that tell the model how to recover. See…
gh-earendil-works-pi.html:
New Features
  • Fullscreen by default — The TUI now runs fullscreen. Set tuiMode to "regular" to keep the terminal's normal scrollback. See Terminal and display.
  • Leaner codemode — About 40% fewer prompt tokens, and errors that tell the model how to recover. See Codemode.
  • Image generation in codemode — Scripts call models.generateImages() with the session's credentials. See Generate images and Use image models.
  • Radius in /login — Sign in with Radius and set up its MCP server in one step. See Radius.
  • Anthropic copy code login — Sign in when the browser runs on another machine. See Authenticate interactively.
  • MCP OAuth hardening — oauth.authServerMetadataUrl, RFC 9207 iss checks, credentials per server, and step-up sign-in that keeps granted scopes. See Authenticate with OAuth.
  • Header-only quiet startup — quietStartup: "header" keeps the version and key hints and hides the rest. See Terminal and display.
Added
  • Added an oauth.authServerMetadataUrl setting for MCP servers that advertise a wrong OAuth authorization server or none. Pi uses the configured metadata document instead of discovery (#10172).
  • Added quietStartup: "header", which keeps the startup header with version and key hints but hides the model scope line and loaded-resource listing.
  • Added models.generateImages() to codemode scripts. It runs image models such as OpenRouter's with the session's credentials and returns base64 image blocks that image() attaches to the result; usage counts toward the session cost like models.classify(). Extensions can call ctx.modelRegistry.generateImages(). See Use image models.
  • Added a copy code login method to Anthropic /login for headless setups where the browser runs on another machine (#10194 by @lucasmeijer).
Changed
  • Changed the default TUI mode to fullscreen. Set tuiMode to "regular" or pass --tui-mode regular to keep the terminal's normal scrollback.
  • /login now offers "Sign in with Radius" at the top level, as the last option, with its status. After a Radius sign-in, /login offers to configure the Radius MCP server in the global mcp.json with "auth": { "provider": "radius" } and reloads. Cancelling a login returns to the menu it was started from.
  • The provider docs page is renamed to Providers, its "Cloud Providers" section is now "Provider Specific Config", and it documents Radius first.
  • MCP OAuth credentials are now stored per server name and URL, so MCP servers with the same URL can sign in with different accounts. Credentials stored by URL alone move to the first server that uses them (#10252).
  • Codemode costs far fewer prompt tokens: with the default tools and codemode active, a GPT-5.6 request shrinks from about 5,300 to 3,300 tokens. The codemode description lists the script globals in one line each and points to the new Codemode reference for the models API, which the model reads when it needs it. Declared tools say in one line how scripts call them and what the call resolves to, instead of repeating their full declaration, and the system prompt's codemode guidance and MCP server section are shorter.
  • Codemode errors now say how to recover: reading a tool or models member that does not exist names the close matches (tools.Bash suggests tools.bash), models.classify() and models.generateImages() reject malformed arguments with the expected shape, an unknown model points to models.getAvailableOfType(), an oversized store() value explains what the store is for, and a script that generates images without showing them gets a note. Scripts that probed for a tool with typeof tools.name must use "name" in tools.
  • /login and /logout now label providers without credentials as "not configured" instead of "unconfigured".
  • OAuth browser pages now show the color Pi logo.
Fixed
  • Fixed MCP OAuth sign-in accepting an authorization response whose iss parameter names another authorization server; the code is now rejected before it is exchanged (RFC 9207).
  • Fixed MCP OAuth sign-in failing with Invalid scope when the token response contains "scope": "", and similar failures for other empty or null optional OAuth fields (#10266).
  • Fixed the sign-in URL printed by /mcp login not being clickable when it wraps (#10186).
  • Fixed --provider without --model being silently ignored and running the default model from another provider; it now fails with an error (#10236).
  • Fixed MCP servers that ask for more scope (insufficient_scope) requesting sign-in over and over. The new sign-in requested only the missing scopes, so the new token lost access the previous one had; it now keeps the granted scopes.
  • Fixed user messages in the transcript keeping two full-width copies of every rendered line; they keep one, with identical output.
  • Fixed /login and /logout labeling every OAuth sign-in, including Radius, as a subscription; only subscription-backed providers say "subscription", other OAuth sign-ins say "account".
  • Fixed the startup header logo rendering with gaps in Apple Terminal; it now shows a colored "Pi" with the version instead.
  • Fixed deferred MCP tools that tool_search loaded being dropped on resume and /reload even when their server reconnected before the next prompt, because the session restored its tools before the MCP servers reconnected.
  • Fixed the system theme making pastel palettes such as Catppuccin Frappe much more vivid; palette colors now keep their chroma (#10255, #10293 by @dgtlntv).
  • Fixed slash command autocompletion not triggering when the input starts with whitespace (#10218 by @haoqixu).
  • Fixed color bleeding past mouse selections and search highlights in fullscreen mode when a styled token ends at the highlight boundary (#10169).
  • Fixed memory retained per rendered message in the transcript; a long assistant message keeps about a fifth of the heap it kept before.

gh-earendil-works-pi.title: Pi v0.99.2
gh-earendil-works-pi.summary: New Features MCP servers stay out of the way: servers with the default codemode exposure are no longer listed in the codemode description and no longer block the first prompt. They appear in a short system prompt section, and scripts find their tools with…
gh-earendil-works-pi.html:
New Features
  • MCP servers stay out of the way: servers with the default codemode exposure are no longer listed in the codemode description and no longer block the first prompt. They appear in a short system prompt section, and scripts find their tools with searchTools() and describeNamespace(). See Control tool exposure.
  • More MCP authentication options: oauth.clientName for servers that only accept known OAuth clients, and "auth": { "provider": "<provider>" } to authenticate HTTP servers with a provider's /login token. See Authenticate with OAuth.
  • Anthropic workload identity federation from the Anthropic SDK environment variables. See Use an API key from the environment.
  • /reload enables tools newly added to the defaultTools setting. See Tools.
Added
  • Added a description field for MCP servers (pi mcp add --description), shown with the server in the system prompt and used to rank its tools in tool search, and a describeNamespace(name) codemode helper that returns a namespace's instructions and tool names. describeNamespace() and searchTools() accept a namespace as mcp__dev-radius, mcp__dev_radius, dev-radius, or dev_radius.
  • Added an oauth.clientName setting for MCP servers (pi mcp add --oauth-client-name) to change the client name sent during OAuth client registration, for servers that only accept known clients (#10226).
  • Added "auth": { "provider": "<provider>" } for HTTP MCP servers to send a provider's current /login token as the bearer token instead of using MCP OAuth. The token is read on every request, so provider refreshes apply. Only allowed in the global mcp.json and from extensions, and requires https except on loopback hosts.
  • Added Anthropic workload identity federation from the ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID, ANTHROPIC_ORGANIZATION_ID, and ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE environment variables (see Providers) (#10177, #10242 by @philfreo).
  • /reload now enables tools newly added to the defaultTools setting. Tools removed from it stay enabled, tools turned off during the session stay off unless newly added, and --tools, --no-tools, and --no-builtin-tools still override the setting (#10245).
Changed
  • MCP servers with the default codemode exposure no longer appear in the codemode description; scripts find them with searchTools(). codemode-deferred is now an alias for codemode. Use direct exposure for tools the model should see without searching (#10212).
  • The codemode description no longer includes deferred tools, tool counts, or MCP server instructions, so it no longer changes when MCP servers connect or change their tools. The tool_search description no longer lists the servers whose tools it can load, for the same reason. Servers are listed instead in an mcp_servers system prompt section with a one-line summary, updated at the start of each prompt; a changed section is appended to the conversation. Scripts read server instructions with describeNamespace() (#10212).
  • The first prompt no longer waits for MCP servers without direct tools. They connect in the background and are waited for when a codemode script names them, a script searches tools, or tool_search runs (#10212).
Fixed
  • Fixed new sessions intermittently ignoring the saved default model, or warning that no models are available, when it belongs to an extension-registered native provider with a stored credential (#9962, #10190 by @davidbrai).
  • Fixed the /mcp sign-in URL not being clickable when it wraps across lines, by emitting it as a terminal hyperlink with a Cmd/Ctrl+click to open line like /login (#10186).
  • Fixed codemode image() accepting malformed base64 data or unsupported image types, which persisted an invalid image block that made every later provider request fail with HTTP 400 (#10215).
  • Fixed codemode failing to start its script worker from the standalone Windows executable (#10204).
  • Fixed prompt submission slowing down with session length, because resolving the session's model selection looked up the model catalog once per assistant message (#10198).
  • Fixed model lookups slowing down for providers with a refreshed pi.dev catalog, because merging remote catalog models took quadratic time.
  • Fixed the built-in-tool-renderer.ts and minimal-mode.ts extension examples removing the built-in tools' summaries and guidelines from the system prompt (#10072, #10193 by @christianklotz).
  • Fixed context overflow detection for Z.AI CN endpoint Prompt exceeds max length errors (#10208).
  • Fixed Anthropic requests failing when a tool schema uses keywords Anthropic strict tool use rejects, such as minimum/maximum; such tools are now sent non-strict (#9953).
  • Fixed provider retries firing immediately when a Retry-After header contains an unparseable date; they now use exponential backoff (#9571).
  • Fixed extension commands registered without a string name or handler crashing pi when typing /; the extension now fails to load with an error instead (#10054).
  • Fixed collapsed codemode and MCP tool results filling the screen when the output is one long line, such as minified JSON. Like bash output, the preview is now limited to wrapped lines instead of logical lines.
  • Fixed codemode.mode: "only" listing read, bash, edit, and write in the system prompt's tool list although requests only declare codemode (#10192).
  • Fixed codemode scripts calling the wrong MCP tool when two tool names differ only in - and _, such as read-file and read_file. Like in Codex, MCP tool and namespace names now replace - with _ (mcp__my-server__x is now mcp__my_server__x), colliding tools of a server all get a hash suffix, and server names that differ only in - and _ are rejected (#10239).
